## ETQAN-QA-700: Academy primary colour never reaches the public site: the tokens stylesheet, loaded after the academy's inline colour, sets `--primary` back to #146B50
- **Feature:** M13 Website admin. **Severity:** P2. **Type:** functional. **Easy P3:** no. **Priority:** high
- **Environment:** local docker stack (backend + dashboard + marketing with uncommitted qa/manual-2026-10 fixes), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`, 1440x900 unless noted. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, manual M13 (M13-F-002); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-10-28.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin@qa.etqan.test / `QA-Admin-2026!`, academy `qa`.
- **Reproduction steps:**
  1. AR: `/app/website/branding`, set اللون الأساسي to `#7A1F5C`, click "حفظ التغييرات" (toast "تم الحفظ.").
  2. Wait 60 s, open `http://qa.etqan.localhost/ar/` and reload.
  3. In devtools: `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--primary')`.
- **Expected:** The header button, hero, "إرسال" etc. use the academy colour (setup guide step 1: "الشعار ولونا الهوية يلوّنان الموقع كله").
- **Actual:** The site stays green. The page contains the academy's inline `:root{--primary:#0E7C66}` (or the new colour), but `global.css` (which imports `@etqan/tokens/theme.css`) is applied after it and sets `:root{--primary: #146B50}` (and `#4FA082`), so computed `--primary` is always `#146B50` — even the default academy colour #0E7C66 is not the one shown. Tagline saved at the same time does show, so the save reaches the site.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/M13/M13-F-002-primary-colour-not-applied.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t001-002-public-footer-primary.png`
- **Notes:** `marketing/src/layouts/Layout.astro:76,101` writes `brandCss` in a `<style>` in `<head>`; `marketing/src/styles/global.css:2-3` imports the tokens theme, which defines `--primary` on `:root` with the same specificity and comes later. Fix idea: raise the brand rule's precedence (e.g. `html:root{…}` or put the brand `<style>` after the stylesheet) — check `ClosedPage.astro:36` too. Every academy's branding colour is affected.
- **Root cause:** `marketing/src/layouts/Layout.astro` and `components/ClosedPage.astro` wrote the brand colours as `:root{--primary:…}`; the bundled `global.css` (tokens `theme.css`) sets the same `:root` vars with equal specificity and is emitted after the inline `<style>`, so it always won.
- **Fix (Agent 3, cycle 1, branch qa/manual-2026-10, uncommitted):** The brand rule is now `html:root{…}` (specificity 0,1,1) in both templates, so it outranks the tokens' `:root` whatever the stylesheet order.
- **Regression test:** `marketing/test/layout.test.ts` (renders `html:root{--primary:`), `marketing/test/closed.test.ts` ("ETQAN-QA-700"). Evidence: `qa/manual/evidence/M13/fix-1/` (dashboard-tsc/vitest/biome, backend-pytest/lint, marketing-vitest/biome).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, 2026-10-28) — computed --primary #7A1F5C on /ar/ and /en/ after saving the colour; restored #0E7C66. Evidence: `qa/manual/screens/M13/fix/ETQAN-QA-700-after.png` (before | after).

## ETQAN-QA-705: Website forms name the URL part differently on each form ("المعرّف (slug)", "العنوان", "العنوان (الرابط)") — "العنوان" is also the title — and several required fields have no *

- **Expected:** One clear name for the URL part on every form (e.g. "رابط الصفحة (slug)" with a hint), and a red * on every required field.

SEO is "عنوان SEO" on articles but "عنوان السيو" on videos. Video "صورة الغلاف" and "ملف الفيديو (MP4)" and FAQ answers carry no * but saving says "اختر صورة الغلاف." / "Required".
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/M13/M13-F-011-category-slug-label.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/M13-F-014-slug-change-hint.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/M13-F-020-video-cover-required-no-star.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t011-category-slug-label.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t014-slug-hint.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t019-video-file-error.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t016-faq-required.png`

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, 2026-10-28) — 'رابط الصفحة (slug)' on pages/articles/categories/videos; new hint wording; * on FAQ answers, bodies, video file/cover; 'عنوان SEO' on videos. Evidence: `qa/manual/screens/M13/fix/ETQAN-QA-705-after.png` (before | after).

- **Expected:** A toast (ideally with تراجع), a way to re-open a handled inquiry, and who/when on handled rows.

Dashboard: success toast with Undo, handled rows show "By <email> · <when>" and a "Mark as new" button (`dashboard/src/features/website/InquiriesList.tsx`, `api.ts`, `queries.ts`, `schemas.ts`; keys in ar/en/es website.json). migrate_schemas applied locally. Decision in round-2/decisions.md.

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (round 2, Agent 2 B gate 2026-10-28, evidence: qa/manual/screens/round-2/B/ETQAN-QA-712-after.png (toast with تراجع); handled view shows "بواسطة qa-admin@… · 28/10/2026، 10:08 م"; reopen endpoint returned the row to new (test data restored); test_admin_api passes)

## ETQAN-QA-718: Emptying the about text saves `<p></p>`, and the public home keeps an empty "من نحن" block that the owner cannot remove from the editor
- **Feature:** M13 Website admin. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy P3:** yes. **Priority:** medium
- **Environment:** local docker stack (backend + dashboard + marketing with uncommitted qa/manual-2026-10 fixes), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`, 1440x900 unless noted. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, manual M13 (M13-F-031); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-10-28.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin@qa.etqan.test / `QA-Admin-2026!`, academy `qa`.
- **Reproduction steps:**
  1. AR `/app/website/home`: click into نبذة (العربية), type a letter, delete it (or select all + Backspace on existing text), "حفظ التغييرات".
  2. `GET /api/v1/site/admin/landing/` → `about_ar`.
  3. Wait 60 s, open `/ar/`.
- **Expected:** No text → no about block (as before any text was entered).
- **Actual:** `about_ar` = `"<p></p>"`; the home page shows the academy card and "من نحن / من نحن" with no text. Only a direct API save of `""` removes it (done to restore).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/M13/M13-F-031-empty-about-still-shown.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t031a-about-cleared-saved.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t031-empty-about-public.png`, `qa/manual/screens/M13/triage/t031b-about-restored.png`
- **Notes:** Normalise empty rich text (`<p></p>`, `<p><br></p>`, whitespace) to "" — in `RichTextEditor` output or the backend sanitiser — so the marketing `about` check works. Also affects FAQ answers / page bodies.
- **Root cause:** `LandingContentSerializer.validate_about_*` only sanitised; an emptied TipTap editor sends `<p></p>`, stored as-is, so the marketing "about" check saw text.
- **Fix (Agent 3, cycle 1, branch qa/manual-2026-10, uncommitted):** Backend: blank sanitised HTML (`is_blank_html`) is stored as "" (`backend/etqan/site/api/admin_serializers.py`).
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/site/tests/test_admin_api.py::test_landing_blank_about_is_stored_empty` (4 blank shapes). Evidence: `qa/manual/evidence/M13/fix-1/` (dashboard-tsc/vitest/biome, backend-pytest/lint, marketing-vitest/biome).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, 2026-10-28) — cleared نبذة in the editor and saved → about_ar '' in DB; public /ar/ has no 'من نحن'. Evidence: `qa/manual/screens/M13/fix/ETQAN-QA-718-after.png` (before | after).

## ETQAN-QA-951: Admin Home: "Net profit this month" headlines the home-currency figure in large red even when the month is positive overall; the other currencies and the overall estimate are small text below

- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M03 (M03-R3-002); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.

- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/` as admin. 2. Look at "صافي ربح هذا الشهر" / "Net profit this month".
- **Expected:** The headline does not suggest a loss when the month is positive overall: show every currency with equal weight, or lead with the labelled overall estimate, and use red only for a negative figure the admin should act on.
- **Actual:** Agent 1 saw a large red "-60.00 ج.م." headline with "100.00 ر.س." and "≈ 1,240.00 ج.م. تقديريًا" in small text below, i.e. the month was about +EGP 1,240. At reproduction time other areas' data had moved the totals (now 66.53 ج.م. positive, later a real loss), but the layout is the same: home currency large, other currencies and estimate small (finance.md: net profit is per currency by design; this bug is only the visual hierarchy).

- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m03.test.tsx` "gives several currencies one size".

## ETQAN-QA-959: Notifications panel (EN UI): Arabic notices are right-aligned while their time stamps are left-aligned, so the list zig-zags

- **Preconditions:** qa-admin EN 1440 (preferred_language ar).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/` in English, open the bell.
- **Expected:** Each notice's time line shares its text's alignment (or every row aligns the same way).
- **Actual:** Arabic titles/bodies right-aligned, their dates ("Oct 28, 2026, 18:05") left-aligned; English rows left-aligned. Note: the Arabic language of the notices in the EN UI (and the English one in the AR UI) is by design (notifications.md, rendered in the recipient's preferred_language; INV-000149 AR/EN pair was created on purpose by the ETQAN-QA-102 gate), so only the alignment is filed.

- **Root cause:** The time line had `dir` = page direction on a block, so it aligned to the page, not the notice.

## ETQAN-QA-971: Regression of ETQAN-QA-106: opening a student that doesn't exist still fires the wallet, notification-preferences and chat-access calls, each 404

## ETQAN-QA-974: Student / parent Home: the "My subscriptions" heading sits 16 px under the Next-session card, while the cards above are 48 px apart
- **Feature:** M03 Home (FamilyHome). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M03 sweep (M03-R3-028); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-student EN and AR, qa-parent EN; 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Sign in as the student and open `/app/`. 2. Measure the section tops/bottoms. 3. Repeat as the parent.
- **Expected:** One vertical rhythm between Home sections: the subscriptions section starts the same distance under the Next-session card as that card does under the dues card.
- **Actual:** EN: dues card ends at 563, Next-session card starts at 611 (48 px); Next-session card ends at 775, "My subscriptions" H2 at 791 (16 px). AR: 570→618 (48 px), 784→800 (16 px). Parent: Next session ends ~775, "My children's subscriptions" at 791 (16 px). The heading added by the ETQAN-QA-968 fix looks glued to the card above it.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/M03-R3-028-student-subscriptions-gap.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/triage/t028-student-home-en.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/triage/t028-student-home-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/triage/t028-parent-home-en.png`
- **Root cause:** `AmountDue` kept a hard-coded `mb-6` from before Home used `PageContainer` (`gap-6`), so the dues card had 24+24 = 48 px under it, while `FamilyHome` stacked its own sections with `gap-4` (16 px). The Home alerts also had `mb-6`.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/billing/AmountDue.tsx` dropped `mb-6`, so the container spaces the card; `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/FamilyHome.tsx` uses `gap-6` (adds `data-testid="family-home"`); `dashboard/src/routes/_authed/index.tsx` Home alerts lose `mb-6`. Now every Home section is 24 px apart: measured for the student and the parent at 1440 EN, dues 563→587 Next, Next 751→775 subscriptions. Side effect: on Invoices (`FamilyInvoices`) the dues card now sits 16 px above the tabs (that page's own `gap-4`), not 40 px. Sanity shots (not verification): `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/a3c3-974-student-en-1440.png`, `a3c3-974-parent-en-1440.png`.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m03.test.tsx` "spaces every Home section by the page's own gap (ETQAN-QA-974)"; `FamilyHome.test.tsx` and `FamilyInvoices.test.tsx` pass.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, cycle 3, 2026-11-01). Every Home section is 24 px apart: student EN 1440 dues 175–563 → Next 587–751 → subscriptions 775 (24/24); student AR 1440 570→594, 760→784; parent EN 1440, parent AR 1440 dark, parent EN 768 dark, student EN 1024 dark and student AR 375 (also the phone tile block, 24) are the same; no sideways scroll. Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/before-974-student-home-en.png`, `before-974-parent-home-en.png`. After: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-974-*.png`. Tests: vitest qa-round3-m03, routes/_authed/index, FamilyHome, FamilyInvoices pass (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M03/gate-3/vitest.txt`).

- **Expected:** On the widest desktop each row reads on one or two lines (as AR does, "2026/11/01 / 12:00"); the table is not dominated by the attendance and action columns.
- **Actual:** Column widths When 97 px, Student 110, Course 89, Status 105, Link 50, Attendance 259, Report 121, Actions 244. "Nov 1, 2026 / 12:00" now takes 2 lines, and the names take 1. No sideways scroll: the table is 1076 px wide and so is its box. Rows stay about 90 px because the labelled attendance selects (label above the select, ETQAN-QA-110) set the minimum height. Rows with "Postponing closed at …" are 112 px. - **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m03.test.tsx` "keeps the teacher's When, Student and Course readable on a wide screen (ETQAN-QA-975)"; `TeacherSessions.test.tsx` and `TeacherSessionTable.test.tsx` pass.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, cycle 3, 2026-11-01) for the 1440 scope of this bug. Teacher EN 1440 light and dark: When 101, Student 144, Course 128 px; "Nov 1, 2026 / 12:00" takes 2 lines and the names take 1; table 1076 = box 1076; docW 1440. AR 1440: 91 px rows, no overflow. Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/before-975-teacher-home-en-1440.png`. After: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-975-teacher-en-1440-light.png`, `-dark.png`, `g3-975-teacher-ar-1440-light.png`. ## ETQAN-QA-976: Supervisor "Today at a glance": the third cell puts "View" beside its hint, the other two put it under the number ("اليوم والقادمة عرض" reads as one phrase)
- **Feature:** M03 Home (supervisor summary card). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.

- **Preconditions:** qa-supervisor EN 1440x900 and AR 375x812.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Sign in as the supervisor and open `/app/`. 2. Compare the three cells of "Today at a glance".

- **Actual:** "Today's sessions 14 / View" and "Missing reports 79 / View" put View under the number; "Sessions you supervise 4" puts "Today and upcoming   View" on one line. On the AR phone it reads "اليوم والقادمة عرض", like one phrase.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/M03-R3-030-supervisor-glance-view-link.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/triage/t030-supervisor-glance-en-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/triage/t030-supervisor-glance-ar-375.png`
- **Root cause:** the `Figure` footer in `StaffTodayCard` was a wrapping row (`flex flex-wrap items-center`). With a hint, "View" sat beside the hint. Without one, it sat alone under the number.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/StaffTodayCard.tsx` makes the footer a column (`flex flex-col items-start gap-1`): the optional hint, then "View" on its own line. The links carry `data-testid="staff-today-open"`. Measured on the AR phone: all three links at x=304, and "اليوم والقادمة" on its own line above "عرض". Sanity shot (not verification): `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/a3c3-976-supervisor-ar-375.png`.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m03.test.tsx` "puts every figure's View link on its own line, under any hint (ETQAN-QA-976)" (a DOM test: each link in a column, and the hint directly before the third link).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, cycle 3, 2026-11-01). All three View links sit on their own line, at the same inline-start position. The hint "Today and upcoming" / "اليوم والقادمة" is on the line above the third link (EN 1440 light: hint at y322–342, View at y346; AR 375: 577–598, then 602 at x334, the same as the other two; AR 768 dark, EN 1024 dark and AR 1440 dark are the same), with no sideways scroll. Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/before-976-supervisor-glance-*.png`. After: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-976-*.png`. Test: qa-round3-m03 passes.

## ETQAN-QA-977: Teacher Home at 768/1024: the Today's-sessions table overflows its card again, "دخلت"/"تأجيل" cut off (regression of ETQAN-QA-955 from the ETQAN-QA-1256 fix)
- **Feature:** M03 Home (TeacherSessions "Today's sessions"; shared `TeacherSessionTable`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 2, M03 gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01 (while retesting ETQAN-QA-975 at the other widths).
- **Preconditions:** qa-teacher with sessions today; AR 768x1024, AR 1024x768, EN 1024x768.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Sign in as the teacher and open `/app/`. 2. Compare the table's scrollWidth with its box.
- **Expected:** As verified for ETQAN-QA-955 at gate cycle 1: the table fits (768 AR 668/668, 1024 AR 660/660) and Report, "دخلت" and "تأجيل" are visible.
- **Actual:** 768 AR: table 728 px in a 668 px box. 1024 AR: 728 in 660. 1024 EN: 793 in 660. The Actions column is cut at the card edge ("دخلت"/"تأجيل" and "أُغلق التأجيل…" half visible), and at 1024 EN the Report column is cut ("Repor", "sessio"). You reach them only by a hidden sideways swipe. The text columns are squeezed again ("Nov / 1, / 2026 / 12:00" on 4 lines, rows 113–132 px). The page itself does not scroll sideways (docW = viewport).
- **Evidence:** before (cycle 1, fits): `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/before-977-cycle1-teacher-768-ar.png`; now: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-977-teacher-ar-768-overflow.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-977-teacher-en-1024-overflow.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-975-teacher-ar-1024-light.png`.
- **Root cause (gate's reading, for Agent 3 to confirm):** `TeacherSessionTable.tsx` wraps `AttendanceControls` in `<div className="sm:w-max">` (ETQAN-QA-1256, M14, after M03 gate cycle 1). From 640 px the two labelled selects sit side by side, so the attendance column is about 212–259 px instead of about 90. That pushes the table past its card at 768 and 1024. The cards view (`phoneCards`) only applies below `sm`.
- **Suggested fix:** keep the side-by-side selects only where the table has room (for example `xl:w-max`, or `2xl` for the narrower History layout if M14 needs it), so that 768/1024 go back to stacked selects. Re-check M14's ETQAN-QA-1256 on My sessions → History at 1440 afterwards, and add a regression test that ties the class to a width that fits.
- **Regression test:** to be added by Agent 3.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, extra cycle):** Root cause confirmed (`sm:w-max` around `AttendanceControls` in `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/TeacherSessionTable.tsx`). Already fixed by the shared ETQAN-QA-1277 change in the same file (M14): the selects sit side by side only from 1440 px (`min-[1440px]:w-max`), 1280–1439 stacks them, and below 1280 the table uses `wideTableCards` (cards, two a row from 768). No further code change was needed; ETQAN-QA-1256 (History at 1440) is kept. Regression test: `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/TeacherSessions.test.tsx` "keeps the attendance selects on one line only where the table has room" (asserts `min-[1440px]:w-max`, none of `sm/md/lg/xl:w-max`, and the `max-xl:block` card layout). Smoke measurements (not verification), Home AR table/box: 768 668/668, 1024 660/660, 1440 1076/1076, page width = viewport; shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix-a3/x977-home-ar-768x1024.png`, `-1024x768.png`, `-1440x900.png`. Scoped vitest: 4 files, 84 tests pass.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, extra cycle 4, 2026-11-01). Teacher Home table/box: AR 768 668/668 and EN 768 668/668 (cards, two a row), AR 1024 660/660 and EN 1024 660/660 (cards), AR 1440 1076/1076 rows 91 px, EN 1440 1076/1076 rows 90–93 px (table, selects side by side); no control cut at the card edge ("دخلت"/"تأجيل", I'm in/Postpone, Report all whole); page width = viewport; no console errors. ETQAN-QA-975 still holds (EN 1440 dark: When 97, Student 144, Course 128 px, names on one line). ETQAN-QA-1256 still holds (My sessions → History: EN 1440 1126/1126 rows 90 px, AR 1440 1126/1126 rows 91 px, selects side by side; AR 768 718/718 and EN 1024 710/710 cards). Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-977-teacher-ar-768-overflow.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g3-977-teacher-en-1024-overflow.png`. After: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M03/fix/g4-977-home-ar-768x1024.png`, `-ar-1024x768.png`, `-ar-1440x900.png`, `g4-977-home-en-768x1024.png`, `-en-1024x768.png`, `-en-1440x900.png`, `g4-975-home-en-1440-dark.png`, `g4-1256-history-en-1440x900.png`, `-ar-1440x900.png`, `-ar-768x1024.png`, `-en-1024x768.png`. Tests (one-off container, --maxWorkers=1): TeacherSessions (incl. "keeps the attendance selects on one line only where the table has room"), qa-round3-m03 → pass (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M03/gate-4/vitest.txt`, 6 files 116 passed).

## ETQAN-QA-1001: Registrations on a phone: page scrolls sideways (397/375), title cut to "لتسجيلات", subtitle cut, e-mails truncated at the start ("…t-180650@example.com")
- **Feature:** M04 People. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.

- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M04 (M04-R3-002); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Retest: scrollWidth 375; full title; e-mail cut at its end. After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1001-after-registrations-375-ar.png; before shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1001-before-*`. Regression tests pass.

## ETQAN-QA-1009: People lists don't share one pattern: status is a pill on some pages and plain text on others; the add button has a "+" icon only on Students/Parents/Teachers; add-button wording mixes noun phrase, verbal noun and imperative; actions sit in different places

(Not included: Staff/Groups names not being links — they have no detail page by design; CSV only on people kinds per people.md.)
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-010-staff-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-010-groups-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-010-families-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-010-parents-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t010-staff-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t011-groups-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t034-sidebar-people.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t032-tags.png`
- **Root cause:** Each list hand-rolled its status cell and add button.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Status is `StatusChip` on Students (`StudentsList.tsx`), Families (`FamiliesList.tsx`, `FamilyPage.tsx`) and Staff (`StaffList.tsx`). Every add button has a "+" (`StaffDialog.tsx`, `FamilyDialog.tsx`, `StudyGroupDialog.tsx`, `NewPersonButton.tsx`; invite uses user-plus) and reads "إضافة …" (new `people.{students,parents,teachers}.add`, `studyGroups.add`, `studyGroups.save` "حفظ المجموعة"). The add buttons of Families/Staff/Groups/Admins moved to the page header (`FamiliesAddAction`, `StaffAddAction`, `StudyGroupsAddAction`, `InviteAdminDialog` in their routes). Decision D-M04-2.
- **Regression test:** `FamiliesList.test.tsx` "shows the status pill…" and "offers Add family in the header…"; `StaffList.test.tsx` status pill; `AdminsList.test.tsx` invite via the header dialog; `ParentsList.test.tsx` and `qa-round3-m03.test.tsx` now expect "Add parent"; e2e `roles.spec.ts` "Add student".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Retest: status pills on Staff/Families/Students; "+" add buttons in the page header on Students, Parents, Teachers, Families, Staff, Groups; Admins invite in the header with a user-plus icon. Note: "إضافة عقد" and "إضافة وسم" still have no "+" (outside this bug's list). After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1009-after-staff-1440-ar.png, qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1009-after-admins-1440-ar.png, qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1011-after-families-1440-ar.png; before shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1009-before-*`. ## ETQAN-QA-1019: Contracts list (AR): file line scrambled again ("2026/10/27 · pdf.عقد خالد") and the teacher's "M04" prefix moves ("الأستاذ خالد الرفاعي M04 · M04-CT-001"): regression of ETQAN-QA-163
- **Feature:** M04 People. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** RTL. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M04 (M04-R3-021); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/people/contracts`.
- **Expected:** "عقد خالد.pdf · 2026/10/27" and "M04 الأستاذ خالد الرفاعي" whole, each part isolated.
- **Actual:** ".pdf" extension jumps before the Arabic file name; "M04" detaches from the teacher name. Likely the premium UI refactor dropped the `<bdi>` isolation added by the QA-163 fix.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-021-contracts-bidi.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t021-contracts-1440.png`
- **Root cause:** Each part was in a first-strong `<bdi>`: "M04 الأستاذ…" became an LTR run (M04 moved to the end), and ".pdf" took the Arabic name's direction.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** New `nameDir()`/`splitFileName()` (`dashboard/src/lib/bidi.ts`) and `IsolatedName`/`FileNameText` (`dashboard/src/components/NameList.tsx`): a name with Arabic is isolated in the UI's direction, Latin names LTR; the extension is its own LTR isolate. `ContractsList.tsx` uses them; the reference is `dir=ltr`.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/lib/bidi.test.ts` "nameDir"; `dashboard/src/components/NameList.test.tsx` "isolates a file name's extension…"; `ContractsList.test.tsx` "isolates the file name and the date".
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, cycle 2):** `dashboard/src/components/NameList.tsx`: `FileNameText`'s outer `<bdi>` now takes the stem's direction (`nameDir(stem, ui)`: RTL for an Arabic name in Arabic, LTR for a Latin one). With only isolates inside, the plain `<bdi>` (dir=auto) found no strong letter and fell back to LTR, which put ".pdf" before "عقد خالد".
- **Regression test (cycle 2):** `dashboard/src/components/NameList.test.tsx` "runs an Arabic file name right to left so the extension ends it".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 2, 2026-11-01): contracts at 1440 AR: the file `<bdi>` is now dir=rtl with "عقد خالد" at x 1080–1127 and ".pdf" at 1055–1080, so the line reads name then extension, then " · 2026/10/27"; Latin names stay LTR ("ui-526170.pdf"); the teacher line stays "M04 الأستاذ خالد الرفاعي · M04-CT-001". Tests: NameList.test.tsx, bidi.test.ts, ContractsList.test.tsx pass. After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1019-after-c2-contracts-1440-ar.png, qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1019-after-c2-contract-row-zoom.png. Earlier history: FIXED (Agent 3, round 3 cycle 2, 2026-11-01), awaiting Agent 2's re-gate. Previous: FAILED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 1, 2026-11-01): the teacher line is fixed ("M04 الأستاذ خالد الرفاعي · M04-CT-001"), but the file line is still out of order: measured at 1440 the ".pdf" isolate sits at x 1102-1127, to the RIGHT of "عقد خالد" (1055-1102), so the RTL line still starts with the extension. Cause: `FileNameText`'s outer `<bdi>` has no `dir`; with only isolates inside, dir=auto finds no strong character and falls back to LTR. The unit test checks attributes only, not the rendering. After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1019-1023-after-contracts-1440-ar.png, qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1019-after-contract-row-zoom.png; before shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/fix/1019-before-*`. Named regression tests pass but do not cover this.

## ETQAN-QA-1037: Students table (1440): pills and status wrap inside narrow cells ("متوقف / مؤقتًا", tag "M04 حافظ جزء / عمّ", family chip spills), rows grow to ~70 px
- **Feature:** M04 People. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M04 (M04-R3-039); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/people/students` (full page).
- **Expected:** Pills on one line (nowrap + truncate with tooltip) and even row height.
- **Actual:** Status breaks on two lines; tag pill breaks inside; family chip "عائلة عبد الرحمن M04 (موقوفة)" wraps under "عائلي"; e-mail breaks at the hyphen.

- **Root cause:** The chips had no `nowrap`, the status was plain text, and the e-mail could break at its hyphen.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/components/TagChips.tsx` and the family chip in `StudentsList.tsx` are `whitespace-nowrap`; the status is a `StatusChip` (nowrap); the e-mail is `dir=ltr`, one line in the table (`xl:whitespace-nowrap`).

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 2, 2026-11-01): students at 1440 AR and EN: the table is 1126 px in its 1126 px box (no inner scroll, page 1440), the Account column shows whole on every row; status, tag and family chips stay on one line, the family chip truncates ("عائلة عبد الرحمن (م…") with the full name as tooltip. Rows are 49–72 px: the taller rows are the two-line "عائلي" + family cell and one long name, not wrapped pills. ## ETQAN-QA-1038: Every table cell spaces each hyphen like a figure ("f02 - staff - ql@qa.etqan.test"): the global `table { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums }` rule also makes Inter's hyphen tabular
- **Feature:** M04 People (shared table style, every area). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M04 sweep (M04-R3-040); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, EN (same for Latin text in AR), 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/people/staff`. 2. Look at the Email column (any table cell with a hyphen: Students e-mails, codes, references in other areas).
- **Expected:** "f02-staff-ql@qa.etqan.test" with a normal tight hyphen, as in the form fields.
- **Actual:** Every hyphen sits in a wide slot: "f02 - staff - ql@qa.etqan.test", "qa - staff - codes@…", "f03 - ui - 1792369207690@…". Computed on the e-mail span: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, font Inter.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-040-staff-email-hyphen-gaps-en.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/M04-R3-040-email-zoom.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t040-staff-table-en.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M04/triage/t040-staff-1440-en.png`
- **Root cause (suspected):** `dashboard/src/index.css` base layer `table { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }` (premium UI) applies `tnum` to all text in every table; Inter's `tnum` feature also substitutes a tabular-width hyphen/minus.
- **Fix:** (Agent 3) Scope tabular figures to numeric cells only (e.g. a `.num`/`tabular-nums` utility on figure columns, or `td:where([data-numeric])`), or keep the rule but neutralise it for text (`font-feature-settings` that keeps `tnum` off for non-numeric cells); verify hyphens in the Staff/Students e-mail cells and that money/number columns stay aligned.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/index.css`: the base `table` rule no longer sets `tabular-nums`; tabular figures apply to figure columns only (`:where(td, th):where(.text-end, .text-right)`), and amounts keep them wherever they sit through `Money` (`dashboard/src/features/billing/bits.tsx`) and the wallet statement's signed amount (`dashboard/src/features/wallet/Statement.tsx`), both now `tabular-nums`. Cells that already had an explicit `tabular-nums` (EtqanBilling, Margins, Moderation, Stat) are unchanged. Decision D-M04-11 (`round-3/decisions.md`): start-aligned date/count cells and the few inline `formatMoney` cells now use Inter's proportional figures (near-uniform; the gain in those columns was marginal).

## ETQAN-QA-1277: My sessions → History at 768/1024: the table is wider than its card; the Report column (and in EN the teacher-attendance select) is cut off behind a hidden sideways scroll
- **Feature:** M14 Teacher portal / sessions (shared `TeacherSessionTable`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M14 confirmation sweep (M14-R3-031); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-teacher with past sessions; AR 1024x768, EN 1024x768, AR 768x1024.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Sign in as the teacher. 2. Open `/app/teaching/sessions` → tab "السجل" / "History". 3. Compare the table's scrollWidth with its box.
- **Expected:** At tablet and small-desktop widths the History table fits its card (stacked attendance selects, or cards), and "كتابة التقرير" / "تعديل التقرير" is fully visible.
- **Actual:** Measured table/box: 1024 AR 755/710, 1024 EN 881/710, 768 AR 755/718; page width = viewport (the overflow is inside the card). AR: "تعديل التقرير" and "بعد انتهاء الحصة" are cut at the card edge. EN: "Teacher attendance" select cut and the whole Report column off-screen; dates wrap to 4 lines ("Oct / 31, / 2026 / 20:00"). Regression from the ETQAN-QA-1256 fix (verified only at 1440). Same root cause as ETQAN-QA-977 (M03, teacher Home/Today, OPEN): fix both together; this entry covers the History tab.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/M14-R3-031-history-1024-report-cut.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/M14-R3-031b-history-768-report-cut.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/triage/t031a-history-1024-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/triage/t031b-history-1024-en.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/triage/t031c-history-768-ar.png`
- **Root cause (triage reading, for Agent 3 to confirm):** `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/TeacherSessionTable.tsx` wraps `AttendanceControls` in `<div className="sm:w-max">`, so from 640 px the two labelled selects sit side by side (~212–259 px column); the table uses `phoneCards`, which only applies below `sm`.
- **Root cause (Agent 3, confirmed):** `sm:w-max` put the two labelled selects side by side from 640 px, and the table (7–8 columns) only became cards below 640 px. Stacking the selects alone is not enough: with stacked selects EN 1024 still measured 737/710 and, with `xl:w-max`, EN 1280 1049/966.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/TeacherSessionTable.tsx` (shared by My sessions and Home's Today, so it also covers ETQAN-QA-977): the table uses the shared `wideTableCards` (cards below 1280 px, two a row from 768) instead of `phoneCards`, and the attendance selects sit side by side only from 1440 px (`min-[1440px]:w-max`); 1280–1439 stacks them (D-M14-9). Measured after (table/box): History AR 375 341/341, AR 768 718/718, EN 768 718/718, AR 1024 710/710, EN 1024 710/710 (cards); EN 1280 966/966, AR 1280 966/966 (table, stacked selects); AR 1440 1126/1126 rows 91 px, EN 1440 1126/1126 rows 90 px (ETQAN-QA-1256 kept). Home Today: EN 1024 660/660 (cards), EN 1280 916/916, EN 1440 1076/1076. Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/fix/f1277-history-*.png`, `f1277-home-*.png`.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/TeacherSessions.test.tsx` "keeps the attendance selects on one line only where the table has room" (selects in `min-[1440px]:w-max`, none of sm/md/lg/xl; table has `max-xl:block` and `md:max-xl:[&_tbody]:grid-cols-2`); `src/ui/phone-cards.test.ts` still checks every cell's `data-label`.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01). History table/box: AR 375 341/341, AR 768 718/718, EN 768 718/718 (also dark), AR 1024 710/710, EN 1024 710/710 (cards, two a row, Report and both selects whole); AR/EN 1280 966/966 (table, stacked selects); AR 1440 1126/1126 rows 91 px, EN 1440 1126/1126 rows 90 px (ETQAN-QA-1256 still holds). Home Today EN 768 668/668, 1024 660/660, 1440 1076/1076. Page width = viewport everywhere, no console errors. After `qa/manual/screens/r3/M14/fix/g3-1277-history-*-after.png`, `g3-1277-home-en-*-after.png`; before: the entry's evidence shots. Tests: TeacherSessions.test.tsx (22), AvailabilityEditor.test.tsx, ui/phone-cards.test.ts: 3 files, 57 passed (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M14/gate-3/vitest.txt`).

## ETQAN-QA-900: Change password (AR): a wrong current password shows the English "Incorrect password." with the full stop on the wrong side
- **Feature:** M02 Account page, change password (`identity/me/password/`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** translation. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 (M02-R3-001); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin@qa.etqan.test / `QA-Admin-2026!`, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/account` → "تغيير كلمة المرور". 2. كلمة المرور الحالية = `wrong-current-1`, new = `Zx9!long-Passw0rd`. 3. Click "تحديث كلمة المرور".
- **Expected:** An Arabic message under the field, e.g. "كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة."
- **Actual:** ".Incorrect password" (English server text, laid out RTL so the period jumps to the start). The other validators on the same form are Arabic. 400 POST /api/v1/identity/me/password/ (expected).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-011-chpw-wrong-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t001-chpw-wrong-ar.png`
- **Notes:** The string comes from the API untranslated; translate it on the server (gettext) or map the error code in the dashboard.

- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/lib/server-messages.ts` maps "Incorrect password." to `errors.server.incorrectPassword`, added in ar/en/es `errors.json` ("كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة."). The same mapping covers the add-email and set-primary dialogs.

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Browser: qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/v900-chpw-wrong-ar.png ("كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة."). Regression tests pass (logs/M02/agent2-gate-vitest.txt; backend test_phone_login + test_email_language 30 passed).

- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 (M02-R3-004); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** teacher `yousef.mansouri@qa.etqan.test` / `QA-People-2026!`, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/account` → "تسجيل الدخول بخطوتين" → "إعداد" → الرمز `123456` → "تأكيد". 2. With 2FA on: "رمز المصادقة أو رمز الاسترداد" = `11111111` → "إيقاف".
- **Expected:** Arabic, the same wording the sign-in code step uses ("الرمز غير صحيح، حاول مرة أخرى.").
- **Actual:** ".Invalid code" in English with the period on the wrong side, in both places. 400 on confirm/disable (expected).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-020-2fa-wrongcode-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t004-2fa-setup-wrongcode-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t004-2fa-disable-wrong-ar.png`
- **Notes:** Screenshot cropped so the setup secret/QR is not kept. Teacher 2FA was switched off again after the repro.
- **Root cause:** `TwoFactorCard.fail` showed the server's `code` field text ("Invalid code.").
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/twofactor/TwoFactorCard.tsx` always shows `twoFactor.invalidCode`; Arabic text aligned with the sign-in step ("الرمز غير صحيح، حاول مرة أخرى.").
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/twofactor/TwoFactorCard.test.tsx` (setup + turn-off wrong code); `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m02.test.ts` "says a wrong 2FA code the sign-in step's way".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Browser: qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/v901-2fa-setup-page-ar.png (setup, secret/QR redacted), v901-910-2fa-disable-wrong-ar.png (turn-off): both "الرمز غير صحيح، حاول مرة أخرى.". ## ETQAN-QA-908: Signing out or switching identity ("sign in as") refetches the old user's queries: 403 console errors on every switch
- **Feature:** M02 Dashboard query cache on logout / impersonation start. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 (M02-R3-009 (+ the 403 burst in M02-R3-033)); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin@qa.etqan.test / `QA-Admin-2026!`, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. On Home open the user menu → "تسجيل الخروج"; watch the network. 2. Sign in again → `/app/people/students/247` → "الدخول بحساب هذا الشخص".
- **Expected:** The query cache is cleared (or reset) when the identity changes; no requests for data the new identity cannot see.
- **Actual:** Logout: 403 GET academy/settings/, notifications/unread-count/, identity/me/ (3 console errors). Sign-in-as: 9 × 403 (etqan-billing/invoices, billing/settings, level-upgrades, registrations, people/tags, people/students/247, guardians, notifications/preferences/247, chat/access/247).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-026-after-logout-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t009-after-logout-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t033-impersonation-banner-ar.png`
- **Notes:** Call `queryClient.clear()` (and cancel in-flight queries) on logout and on impersonation start/stop.
- **Root cause:** Logout cleared the cache while the shell and page were still mounted; sign-in-as reset all queries while the old person's page was still mounted, so they refetched as the new identity.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/shell/AppShell.tsx`: on sign-out the shell unmounts itself (`flushSync`), then cancels and clears the cache, then goes to `/login`; `useLogout` only cancels. `dashboard/src/features/quicklogin/queries.ts` `useSwitchSession`: cancel, set the new `me`, navigate away from the old page, and only then `resetQueries`; sign-in-as and stop no longer navigate on their own (D-M02-4).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/shell/AppShell.test.tsx` "does not refetch the page's data after signing out" (test tree now mirrors the `_authed` layout); `dashboard/src/features/quicklogin/queries.test.tsx` "does not refetch the old page's queries as the new person".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Browser: qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/v908-after-logout-ar.png (teacher), v908-admin-after-logout-ar.png (admin from Home): only the login page's own anonymous GET identity/me 403 (same as a cold load); sign-in-as student 247 (v931-signin-as-dialog-ar-375.png, v932-*): no 403s. Regression tests pass (logs/M02/agent2-gate-vitest.txt; backend test_phone_login + test_email_language 30 passed).

## ETQAN-QA-916: Sign-in with a phone number in local format ("01009990947") is refused as wrong credentials
- **Feature:** M02 Login by phone (`signin.identify`, phone path). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 (M02-R3-017); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** signed out, AR, 1440x900; student.ind6 has phone +201009990947, academy timezone Africa/Cairo.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/login` → "البريد الإلكتروني أو الهاتف" = `01009990947`, password `QA-People-2026!` → "تسجيل الدخول". 2. Repeat with `+20 100 999 0947`.
- **Expected:** The number is normalised with the academy's country (Egypt) and the user signs in — or the field tells the user to use the +country form.
- **Actual:** "بيانات الدخول غير صحيحة." (400) — the user is told the credentials are wrong although only the phone format differs; the +20 form signs in fine; no hint on the page.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-039-phone-login-local.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-040-phone-login-intl.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t017-phone-local-ar.png`
- **Notes:** sign-in.md describes exact phone matching; normalising with the academy's default region (phonenumbers) is additive.
- **Root cause:** Sign-in matched phones exactly; stored phones are international.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** New `backend/etqan/platform/phones.py` `international()` (national "0" → the academy country's calling code from its timezone; "00" → "+"); `backend/etqan/identity/signin.py` `_phone` uses it (not on the public schema). No migration, no new dependency (D-M02-1).
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/identity/tests/test_phone_login.py` `test_local_number_signs_in_with_the_academy_country`, `test_local_number_elsewhere_stays_refused`, `test_international_keeps_other_numbers`.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Browser: qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/v916-phone-local-login-ar.png ("01009990947" signs student.ind6 in). Regression tests pass (logs/M02/agent2-gate-vitest.txt; backend test_phone_login + test_email_language 30 passed).

## ETQAN-QA-917: Account: after saving or clearing the phone number the WhatsApp card keeps the old state until a full reload
- **Feature:** M02 Account page, WhatsApp card (`notifications/whatsapp/` query not invalidated). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 (M02-R3-018); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** student `student.ind6@qa.etqan.test` / `QA-People-2026!` (phone +201009990947), AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/account` → clear "الهاتف" → "حفظ التغييرات" → the WhatsApp card still says "تصلك الإشعارات أيضًا على واتساب…"; reload → "أضف رقم هاتف…". 2. Enter `+201009990947` → "حفظ التغييرات" → the card still says "أضف رقم هاتف إلى ملفك الشخصي…".
- **Expected:** The WhatsApp card updates as soon as the profile is saved.
- **Actual:** Stale in both directions until reload (the toggle stays disabled after adding a phone).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-037-student-setphone.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-038-student-whatsapp-after-reload.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t018-whatsapp-stale-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t018-whatsapp-stale-after-clear-ar.png`

## ETQAN-QA-934: Profile name over 255 characters: ungrammatical default Arabic validator and no length limit on the field
- **Feature:** M02 Account page, ProfileEditForm / `identity/me/` PATCH. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** translation. **Easy:** yes.

- **Preconditions:** student `student.ind6@qa.etqan.test` / `QA-People-2026!` (phone +201009990947), AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/account` → "الاسم الكامل" = 320 characters → "حفظ التغييرات".
- **Expected:** The input stops at 255 (`maxLength`) or a natural message, e.g. "الاسم طويل جدًا، الحد الأقصى 255 حرفًا."
- **Actual:** Input `maxLength` is -1 (none); server message "تأكد ان عدد الحروف في هذا الحقل لا تتجاوز 255." (Django default: "ان" without hamza, gender mismatch). 400 PATCH identity/me/.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/r3-077-profile-longname.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t036-longname-ar.png`
- **Notes:** Same server message as ETQAN-QA-1016 (people forms); this is the Account page form (`ProfileEditForm`, PATCH `identity/me/`), which needs its own maxLength. Not saved (400).
- **Root cause:** No client limit, so Django's default Arabic validator message showed.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/identity/schemas.ts` `full_name` `.max(255, account.nameTooLong)` (ar/en/es) and `maxLength={255}` on the input (`ProfileEditForm.tsx`) (D-M02-8).
- **Regression test:** `ProfileEditForm.test.tsx` "stops the name at 255 characters and says so".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Browser: qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/maxLength=255 on full_name checked in the browser (v900-926-account-ar.png); schema message covered by the test. ## ETQAN-QA-937: Top bar (AR): the notification count "99+" shows as "+99"
- **Feature:** M02/M03 Top bar, NotificationBell badge (shared, every dashboard screen). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** RTL. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL

- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/account` at 1440x900 (light) and 375x812 (dark). 2. Look at the bell badge in the top bar.
- **Expected:** "99+" in both languages (the count isolated as LTR, e.g. `dir="ltr"`/`<bdi>` on the badge).
- **Actual:** The badge `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -end-1 -top-1 …">99+</span>` has computed `direction: rtl`, so the "+" jumps in front and reads "+99" (like a plus-sign number or phone prefix). EN shows "99+".
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/sweep/w04-topbar-zoom.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t039-header-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t039-account-ar-375-dark.png`
- **Root cause:** The badge inherits the page's RTL direction, so the bidi algorithm moves the neutral "+" in front of the digits.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/notifications/NotificationBell.tsx`: the count is wrapped in `<bdi dir="ltr">` (the badge itself keeps the page direction, so `-end-1` stays on the correct side).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/notifications/NotificationBell.test.tsx` "caps the badge at 99+" now also asserts the count is `dir="ltr"`.
- **Status:** VERIFIED
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): qa-admin AR, badge reads "99+" at 1440 light and 375 dark (`<bdi dir="ltr">`, badge still at the top end). Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/triage/t039-header-ar-1440.png`, `t039-account-ar-375-dark.png`; after: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M02/fix/v937-938-account-admin-ar-1440.png`, `v937-account-ar-375-dark.png`, `v937-topbar-ar-375-dark-zoom.png`. ## ETQAN-QA-938: Language switch: the same icon button says "EN" (code, target language) before sign-in and "العربية" (name, current language) after
- **Feature:** M02 Auth layout / top bar, `dashboard/src/ui/locale-toggle.tsx`. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** copy. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M02 sweep (M02-R3-040); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** signed out (AR and EN), then signed in as qa-admin (AR, Spanish on so the top bar shows the menu).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/login` in AR at 1440: the language button reads "EN" (68 px wide). 2. Same page in EN: it reads "العربية" (87 px). 3. Sign in (AR): the top-bar language button with the same icon reads "العربية", the current language.
- **Expected:** One labelling convention for the same icon+label control: either always the current language's full name, or always the full name of the language it switches to. Never a code in one direction and a full name in the other.
- **Actual:** The two-way toggle uses `next === "ar" ? "العربية" : "EN"`, so it mixes a code and a full name and has two widths. Before sign-in "العربية" means "switch to Arabic". After sign-in, in the menu, it means "you are in Arabic".

## ETQAN-QA-1203: "تسجيل الدفع" and "الدفع إلى الرصيد" dialogs don't name the teacher, payslip or amount; the two page buttons look identical
- **Feature:** M09 Payslip page / pay dialogs. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** copy. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL

- **Expected:** Like the withdrawal dialogs after ETQAN-QA-374, the title names the teacher, payslip number and net (e.g. "تسجيل دفع 60.00 ج.م. للمعلم F10 Teacher Seven (PAY-000012)"); the two actions are visually distinguishable (one primary, one secondary) or carry a hint.
- **Actual:** Generic "تسجيل الدفع / سجّل تاريخ دفع راتب المعلم." and "الدفع إلى الرصيد / أضف صافي هذا الراتب إلى رصيد المعلم بتاريخ الدفع…"; both page buttons are identical green primaries side by side.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/s008-markpaid-dialog-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/s009-tobalance-dialog-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t004-markpaid-dialog-ar.png`
- **Root cause:** The dialogs used the button text as title; both page buttons were primary.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/payroll/MarkPaidDialog.tsx`: title names amount, teacher and number (new keys paid.titleFor "تسجيل دفع {{amount}} للمعلم {{teacher}} ({{number}})", balance.payTitleFor "إضافة {{amount}} إلى رصيد المعلم …"), values isolated; "الدفع إلى الرصيد" trigger is outline (secondary).
- **Regression test:** `PayslipPage.r3.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1203".
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, cycle 2):** new shared helper `unbrokenName()` in `dashboard/src/lib/bidi.ts` (`bidiName` + no-break spaces; names over 32 characters keep normal spaces so they can still wrap in a narrow dialog). Used for the teacher in `MarkPaidDialog.tsx` (Mark paid + Pay to balance titles), in `withdrawal-text.ts` `withdrawalWords()` (approve / pay / reject / cancel withdrawal titles), and replaces the inline `.replace(/ /g, "\u00a0")` of the 1202 issuer fact in `PayslipPage.tsx`.
- **Regression test (cycle 2):** `dashboard/src/lib/bidi.test.ts` "ETQAN-QA-1203"; `PayslipPage.r3.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1203: the pay dialogs keep a multi-word teacher name on one line"; `WithdrawalsPage.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1203: the approve title keeps a multi-word teacher name on one line".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, round 3 gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): Mark paid and Pay to balance titles keep "F10 Teacher Seven" on one line at 1440 and 375 (AR); withdrawal approve title keeps "QA teacher" together; issuer fact (1202) still keeps "QA Admin" together. Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1203-1204-after-markpaid-ar.png`, `1203-after-tobalance-ar.png`, `1222-after-approve-dialog-ar.png`; after: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1203-c2-after-markpaid-ar.png`, `1203-c2-after-tobalance-ar.png`, `1203-c2-after-markpaid-ar-375.png`, `1203-c2-after-approve-withdrawal-ar.png`. Regression tests: 9 files / 93 tests green, payroll suite 20 files / 252 green (`qa/manual/round-3/logs/M09/agent2-gate2-vitest*.txt`).
- **Previous verification (cycle 1):** FAILED (Agent 2, round 3 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): the titles now name amount, teacher and number and the to-balance trigger is outline, but both new titles break the teacher name across lines at 1440 ("…للمعلم F10 Teacher" / "(PAY-000012) Seven"), the mid-name wrap ETQAN-QA-1202 calls a defect. Keep the name together (no-break spaces as in the 1202 fix). Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1203-1204-after-markpaid-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1203-after-tobalance-ar.png`. The withdrawal approve title wraps "QA" / "teacher" the same way (`1222-after-approve-dialog-ar.png`); fix it with the same helper.

- **Expected:** Full, consistent labels with currency ("سعر الساعة (ج.م.)", "الراتب الشهري (ج.م.)"); one term per concept; selects with the same placeholder; hint next to the field it describes.

- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/s019-add-rate-dialog-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/s025-fixed-salary-dialog-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/s027-student-rate-dialog-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t010-rate-decimals-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t011-fixed-salary-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t011-student-rate-ar.png`
- **Root cause:** Fragment labels and mixed أجر/سعر terms; placeholder and hint inconsistencies.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Locales: rates.amount "سعر الساعة ({{currency}})", fixed.amount "الراتب الشهري ({{currency}})", rates.body full sentence, studentRates.* use "سعر" (D-M09-1), bulk.rate/course; `StudentRateDialog.tsx` teacher select placeholder "اختر معلمًا" and full amount label; `FixedSalary.tsx` empty month "هذا الشهر", hint moved into the field (`Field hint`).
- **Regression test:** `payroll-copy.test.ts` "ETQAN-QA-1208"; RatesPage/FixedSalary/StudentRates/BulkRatesDialog tests updated to the new labels.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, cycle 2):** (a) shared `dashboard/src/features/people/StudentPicker.tsx` gets an optional `placeholder` prop (default stays "—" for other callers); `StudentRateDialog.tsx` passes new key `payroll.studentRates.chooseStudent` ("اختر طالبًا" / "Choose a student" / "Elige un alumno"), matching the teacher select's "اختر معلمًا". (b) `payroll.fixed.startsOnHint` reworded so it no longer says "leave it empty" next to a select that shows "هذا الشهر": AR "اختر شهرًا لاحقًا ليبدأ الراتب منه.", EN "Pick a later month to start the salary then.", ES added (decision D-M09-9).
- **Regression test (cycle 2):** `StudentRates.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1208: the teacher and student selects start with the same kind of placeholder"; `payroll-copy.test.ts` "ETQAN-QA-1208: the student select reads like the teacher one; the start-month hint matches the 'this month' option".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, round 3 gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): per-student dialog selects read "اختر معلمًا" / "اختر طالبًا" (EN "Choose a teacher" / "Choose a student"); fixed-salary hint now "اختر شهرًا لاحقًا ليبدأ الراتب منه." under "هذا الشهر" (EN "Pick a later month to start the salary then."), AR 1440 light and EN 375 dark. Before: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1208-after-student-rate-ar.png`, `1208-after-fixed-salary-ar.png`; after: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1208-c2-after-student-rate-ar.png`, `1208-c2-after-fixed-salary-ar.png`, `1208-c2-after-student-rate-en-375-dark.png`, `1208-c2-after-fixed-salary-en-375-dark.png`. Regression tests green (`qa/manual/round-3/logs/M09/agent2-gate2-vitest*.txt`).
- **Previous verification (cycle 1):** FAILED (Agent 2, round 3 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): the rate and fixed-salary labels are fixed and the per-student amount gets "(EGP)" once a teacher is chosen, but (a) the per-student dialog still has inconsistent select placeholders: teacher "اختر معلمًا", student "—"; (b) the fixed-salary hint "اتركه فارغًا ليبدأ هذا الشهر." still sits under both selects and now contradicts the month select, which shows "هذا الشهر" rather than an empty value. Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1208-after-student-rate-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/fix/1208-after-fixed-salary-ar.png`.

## ETQAN-QA-1232: Adjustments and Withdrawals filter rows: the primary button is 40 px next to 44 px selects (1231 fix only reached Payslips)
- **Feature:** M09 Adjustments, Withdrawals. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M09 confirmation sweep (M09-R3-035); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR or EN, 1440 or 375, light or dark.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/payroll/adjustments`, compare "إضافة تسوية" with the two selects. 2. Open `/app/payroll/withdrawals`, compare "طلب جديد" / "New request" with the selects.
- **Expected:** The button matches the select height and baseline, as on Payslips after ETQAN-QA-1231.
- **Actual:** AR 1440 adjustments: selects 44 px (top 175), "إضافة تسوية" 40 px (top 179). EN 375 dark withdrawals: status select 44 px (top 231), "New request" 40 px (top 235). The button sits shorter and off the selects' line.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/M09-R3-035-filter-button-height-adjustments-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/M09-R3-035-filter-button-height-withdrawals-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/M09-R3-035-filter-button-height-en375-dark.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t035-filter-button-adjustments-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M09/triage/t035-filter-button-withdrawals-en375-dark.png`
- **Root cause:** (suspected) `size="sm"` buttons in the 44 px filter row of `AdjustmentsPage` / `WithdrawalsPage`; ETQAN-QA-1231 changed only Payslips and `ExportButton`. Prefer one shared filter-row rule over per-page patches.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Root cause confirmed: the two "new" dialog triggers that sit in the 44 px filter rows were `size="sm"` (40 px ink). `dashboard/src/features/payroll/AdjustmentDialog.tsx`: the trigger is the default `md` (h-11) in add mode and stays `sm` in edit mode (dense table rows). `dashboard/src/features/payroll/WithdrawalDialog.tsx`: the trigger takes the default size (it is the filter-row action on Withdrawals and a standalone action on My balance). Same rule as 1231: a filter-row action matches the 44 px controls beside it; `sm` stays for in-row actions. No shared filter-row component exists to carry the rule, and the `sm` size is deliberately 40 px app-wide (ADR-0040), so the fix is at the two triggers.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/payroll/AdjustmentsList.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1232: Add is as tall as the filter selects; row Edit stays dense"; `dashboard/src/features/payroll/WithdrawalsPage.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1232: New request is as tall as the filter selects beside it". - **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Root cause: the shared `Label` is a flex row, so when the text wrapped, the "*" became a separate item at the far edge. ## ETQAN-QA-1132: Today and Simplified view still show the green "مجدولة" for a past session nobody marked, while the Sessions list flags it "لم يُسجَّل الحضور"
- **Feature:** M07 Today / Simplified view status badge. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.

- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/scheduling/sessions` (period اليوم): the 10:00 QA6 Student SA row shows red "لم يُسجَّل الحضور". 2. Open `/app/scheduling/today`: the same row shows green "مجدولة". 3. Open `/app/scheduling/sessions/simple` (اليوم 01/11/2026): the same card shows green "مجدولة".
- **Expected:** One status rule across the office pages: the ETQAN-QA-1102 rule (SessionStateChip, D-M07-2) also on Today and the Simplified view, which are where the office marks attendance.
- **Actual:** Only SessionsList uses SessionStateChip. `SimpleSessions.tsx` still renders `SessionStatusChip status={session.status}` (raw status), and `TodayBoard.tsx` maps the server's `row.state` to "مجدولة" for the passed, unmarked session. The same session has two states depending on the page. Same in EN ("Scheduled").
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/M07-R3-037-simple-past-scheduled.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/M07-R3-037b-today-past-scheduled.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/M07-R3-037c-list-flagged.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/triage/t037-today-past-scheduled.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/triage/t037b-simple-past-scheduled.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M07/triage/t037c-list-flagged.png`
- **Notes:** Follow-up of ETQAN-QA-1102 (fixed only on the Sessions list). Files to look at: dashboard/src/features/scheduling/SimpleSessions.tsx, TodayBoard.tsx (and the backend Today `state` if it decides the label).
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Root cause: only SessionsList used the QA-1102 rule; the Simplified view showed the raw status and the Today board mapped the server's `generated` (= session status SCHEDULED, `scheduling/services/board.py`) straight to "مجدولة". ## ETQAN-QA-1176: Phone (375): local payment method name is broken over two lines and covered by the currency pill
- **Feature:** M08 Local payment methods list. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend/dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa` unless noted, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M08 (M08-R3-034); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 375x812.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/billing/local-methods`.
- **Expected:** Name, pill, toggle and buttons wrap onto their own lines.
- **Actual:** "M08 إنستاباي" split and overlapped by "EGP"; "الترتيب 0" squeezed under it.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-034-phone-local-method-overlap.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t034-phone-local-methods.png`
- **Root cause:** The name block was `min-w-0 flex-1` in the same wrap row as the pill and controls.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/billing/LocalMethodsPage.tsx` (method row = logo+name+pill with `basis-56`, controls wrap below on a phone; delete outlined).
- **Regression test:** `LocalMethodsPage.test.tsx` passes; visual (Agent 2).
- **Verification status:** FAILED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): at 1440 the row is right, and at 375 the name is on one line with no overlap. But on a phone the method row (`flex min-w-0 flex-1 basis-56`) sits in a column flex, so `basis-56` becomes a 224 px height: the card shows a ~180 px empty band above the name. Measured H=224 in a `flex-direction: column` parent. Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/fix/1176-before.png` / `1176-after.png` / `1176-after-1440.png`.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, cycle 2):** `dashboard/src/features/billing/LocalMethodsPage.tsx`: the method row's `flex-1 basis-56` now applies only from `sm` (`sm:flex-1 sm:basis-56`), where the parent is a row; in the phone's column it no longer becomes a 224 px height. **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/billing/qa-m08-r3.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1176".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): at 375 AR the method row is 283x45 in the column parent (no empty band), name on one line, pill and controls below with no overlap and no sideways scroll; at 1440 AR dark the row is one line (861x45 in a row parent). Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/fix/1176-after-c2.png`, `1176-after-c2-1440-dark.png`. Vitest `qa-m08-r3.test.tsx` + `LocalMethodsPage.test.tsx` pass.
- **Status:** VERIFIED.

## ETQAN-QA-1188: Phone cards show label rows with nothing in them (links "الإجراءات", codes "الدورة · الباقة"/"المعلم", expenses "ملاحظات"/"إجراءات", online payments "Paid by"/"Transaction"/"Actions")
- **Feature:** M08 billing lists on a phone (shared `phoneCards` / `wideTableCards` recipe). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.

The column is "الإجراءات" on links but "إجراءات" on expenses/donations/exchange rates.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-047-phone-cards-empty-rows.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-047b-phone-cards-empty-rows-en.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t047-links-phone-ar-paid.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t047-codes-phone-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t047-checkouts-phone-en.png`

One actions header: `ar/finance.json` `fields.actions` "إجراءات" → "الإجراءات" (as links/vouchers/billing).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/billing/qa-m08-r3.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1188" (recipe class, empty `<td>` has no child nodes, page sources, one AR actions term).

## ETQAN-QA-1189: Billing filter bars: uneven select widths and a split date range on phone; From/To labels are smaller and lower than the other filter labels on desktop
- **Feature:** M08 billing list filter bars (donations, expenses, payments, codes, links). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** no (shared layout).
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend/dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M08 sweep (M08-R3-048); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. AR 375x812 `/app/billing/donations` (also expenses, payments). 2. EN 375 `/app/billing/codes`. 3. EN 1440x900 `/app/billing/links`, compare the filter labels.
- **Expected:** One shared filter layout: equal-width selects (full-width or 2-up) on phone, "من" and "إلى" side by side, export and create together; at desktop all filter labels the same size on one baseline (as fixed for sessions in ETQAN-QA-1100).
- **Actual:** Donations AR 375: "من" sits next to the currency select, "إلى" drops to the next row beside "تصدير CSV", "إضافة تبرع" alone on a third row. Codes EN: selects of different widths with ragged edges. Links EN 1440: Status/Type/Provider labels are 13px at y=175, From/To are 12px at y=180.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-048-phone-filter-bar-ragged.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-048b-phone-filters-uneven.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/M08-R3-048c-date-labels-lower.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t048-donations-phone-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/triage/t048-links-en-1440.png`
- **Root cause:** Each billing list built its own flex-wrap row; select labels were `text-sm font-medium` (13 px) on links/codes/payments/checkouts, `text-xs` on dates/finance.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/finance/shared.tsx` (the billing lists' shared filter module): new `FilterBar` (2-column grid on a phone, wrapping row from `sm`), `DateRange` (From/To side by side, whole row on a phone), `FilterActions` (export + create together), `filterLabel` used by `FilterField` and `DateFilter` (one size/colour/baseline); `SearchBox` spans the row on a phone; date input `sm:w-auto`. Applied in `DonationsList.tsx`, `ExpensesList.tsx`, `PaymentRecordsPage.tsx`, `CodesPage.tsx`, `PaymentLinksPage.tsx`, `CheckoutsList.tsx` (their own `text-sm font-medium` labels replaced by `FilterField`). Invoices keeps its folded `PhoneFilters` (ETQAN-QA-315).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/billing/qa-m08-r3.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1189" (grid/col-span classes, identical label class, all six pages use `<FilterBar>` with no `text-sm font-medium` label).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): retested in the browser, before/after in `qa/manual/screens/r3/M08/fix/` 1189-before-donations-phone-ar.png / 1189-after-donations-ar-375.png (also codes EN 375, links EN 1440: Status/Type/Provider/From/To all 12px on y=175; expenses AR 768 dark); regression tests pass (vitest 39 files/312 incl. qa-m08-r3 24/24 and ExchangeRatesList 12/12; `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M08/agent2-gate3-vitest.txt`).

- **Feature:** M06 scheduling copy (`scheduling.json`, schedules). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** translation. **Easy:** yes.

- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M06 sweep (M06-R3-046); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Follow-up of ETQAN-QA-1070 (pieces isolated, separator not).
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR and EN, 1440.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/scheduling/schedules/calendar`. 2. Look at the Tuesday/Monday "Daniel Carter" cards and the short "QA6 Student …" cards.
- **Expected:** The separator stays attached to one of the pieces (or each piece on its own line without a dot); no line consists of only "·" and no line starts with it.
- **Actual:** AR: "اللغة العربية للناطقين بغيرها" / "·" / "الأستاذة مريم الخطيب (Maryam Al-Khatib)" (dot alone on the middle line); short cards wrap as "· قرآن" / "QA6 Teacher C". EN: "Arabic for Non-Native Speakers" / "·" / teacher; "QA6 Quran ·" / "QA teacher".
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/M06-R3-046-calendar-orphan-dot.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-046-cal-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-047-cal-en-1440.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Root cause: the "·" was its own flex item between the course and teacher pieces, so a narrow column wrapped it onto a line of its own. ## ETQAN-QA-1093: Filled red buttons remain on other screens after the subscription page moved to outline red; non-destructive "أرشفة" is filled red
- **Feature:** M06 danger buttons: subscriptions list row "أرشفة", trial "حذف الطلب", study groups "حذف" (also teacher account "تعطيل"). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M06 sweep (M06-R3-050); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01 (also seen as an observation at gate 1). Follow-up of ETQAN-QA-1054/1064.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin AR 1440.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/scheduling/subscriptions` → a cancelled row. 2. `/app/scheduling/trials/5`. 3. `/app/people/groups`. 4. Compare with `/app/scheduling/subscriptions/111` ("إلغاء الاشتراك", slot "حذف") and the archive ("حذف نهائي").
- **Expected:** One danger-button style in the area (outline red, as chosen for 1054/1064); archiving a cancelled subscription is reversible and shouldn't look destructive at all.
- **Actual:** Row "أرشفة" is solid red (bg rgb(172,87,78), white text); trial "حذف الطلب" solid red; study-group "حذف" solid red; while the permanent "حذف نهائي" and "إلغاء الاشتراك" are only outlined.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-050-subs-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-049-trials_5.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-050-people_groups.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-052-sub111-slots.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/sweep/w-people_teachers_217-ar-1440.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Fix: every M06 confirmation trigger states its variant; danger triggers are `destructiveOutline` (trial "حذف الطلب" in `TrialPage.tsx`, study-group "حذف" in `StudyGroupsList.tsx`, bulk schedule "حذف" in `ScheduleActions.tsx`, schedule card "إزالة" in `ScheduleStatusCard.tsx`, bundle roster remove in `BundleActions.tsx`); the reversible "أرشفة" (`ArchiveActions.tsx`) and bundle "استرجاع الحزمة" are `outline` and confirm in primary, not red. The confirmations of real deletes keep the filled red button. The teacher account "تعطيل" (people area, M04) is left to that area's owner. The shared `Confirm` default was not changed, because other areas' tests and screens rely on it. Regression test: `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m06.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1093" (no M06 Confirm falls back to the filled default; archive is outline).
- **Verification status:** FAILED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): in M06 itself the fix holds — list "أرشفة" is neutral outline and its confirm is primary green; trial "حذف الطلب", study-group "حذف", bundle "إلغاء/فكّ الحزمة" are outline red; real-delete confirms keep the filled red. But the teacher account "تعطيل" that triage put in this bug's scope is still solid red (`/app/people/teachers/217`, bg rgb(172,87,78), white text, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-ref-1093-teacher217.png`) and it was left out without an accepted proposal. Fix: make that trigger `destructiveOutline` (one-line, keep M04's lines), or log a hand-off to M04 in round-3/decisions.md. Before `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-050-subs-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-049-trials_5.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-050-people_groups.png`; after `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1093-subs-cancelled-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1093-archive-confirm.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-trial5-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1093-trial-delete-confirm.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-groups-ar-1440.png`. Regression test passes (gate3-vitest.log).
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, extra cycle):** `dashboard/src/features/people/AccountActions.tsx` (M04's uncommitted lines kept): the account "تعطيل" Confirm gets `triggerVariant="destructiveOutline"`, and the disabled "تعطيل" button (shown when deactivation is blocked) is `destructiveOutline` too; the confirmation dialog keeps the filled red button. Regression test: `dashboard/src/features/people/AccountActions.test.tsx` "outlines the Deactivate trigger instead of filling it red" (trigger has the outline class, not `bg-destructive`; the dialog's confirm is `bg-destructive`). Smoke check (not verification): `/app/people/teachers/217` AR 1440, "تعطيل" bg transparent, red text; shot `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix-a3/x1093-teacher217-ar-1440.png`. tsc: clean for these files (the one remaining error is in another area's `src/features/billing/qa-m08-r3.test.tsx:295`).
- **Verification status (gate extra cycle 4):** VERIFIED (Agent 2, 2026-11-01). `/app/people/teachers/217` AR 1440: "تعطيل" is outline red (bg transparent, text rgb(172,87,78), red border); its confirmation keeps the filled red "تعطيل حساب QA6 Teacher B" (bg rgb(172,87,78)), dismissed without confirming. M06 triggers still outline: trial "حذف الطلب", study groups "حذف" ×2, archive "حذف نهائي" all bg transparent / red text. Before (failing, cycle 3): `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-ref-1093-teacher217.png`. After: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g4-after-1093-teacher217-deactivate-btn.png`, `g4-after-1093-teacher217-confirm.png`, `g4-after-trial5-ar-1440.png`, `g4-after-groups-ar-1440.png`, `g4-after-archive-ar-1440.png`.
