## ETQAN-QA-1094: Arabic action labels mix imperative and verbal-noun forms on the same screen
- **Feature:** M06 action labels: subscription page, bundle page, weekly schedules, study groups, subscriptions list/new. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** translation. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M06 sweep (M06-R3-051); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Related decision R3-M06-D2 (one term per action).
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin AR 1440.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/scheduling/subscriptions/111`. 2. `/app/scheduling/bundles/2`. 3. `/app/scheduling/schedules`, `/app/people/groups`, `/app/scheduling/subscriptions`.
- **Expected:** One form for buttons across the area (e.g. imperative "أضف / جدّد / جمّد / عدّل"), following round-3 glossary when it exists.
- **Actual:** Subscription page: "افتح التجديد" (imperative) next to "تعديل" / "إلغاء الاشتراك" (nouns); "أضف مواعيد" next to "إضافة تجميد"; slot "تعديل" / "إيقاف" / "استئناف". Bundle: "جدّد الحزمة"، "ألغِ الحزمة"، "فكّ الحزمة"، "عدّل الملاحظات" next to "تجميد الحزمة". Lists: "إضافة جدول"، "إضافة مجموعة دراسية" vs "اشتراك جديد"، and submit "أنشئ الاشتراك".
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-049-subscriptions_111.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-052-sub111-slots.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-049-bundles_2.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-052-schedules.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-050-people_groups.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Decision R3-M06-D9 (decisions.md): buttons use the verbal noun, matching D-M04-2 "إضافة …" and the area's existing "تعديل / حذف / إلغاء الاشتراك / إضافة تجميد"; hints and error prompts ("ابحث عن طالب", "اختر واحدًا.") stay imperative. ar changes: scheduling `renew.action/confirm` "تجديد", `renew.open` "فتح التجديد", `renew.previous` "فتح المدة السابقة", `form.create` "إنشاء الاشتراك", `slots.add/addGroup` "إضافة مواعيد", `slots.removeGroup` "حذف هذه المواعيد", new `addAction` "إضافة اشتراك" for the list button (`SubscriptionsList.tsx`; "اشتراك جديد" stays the page title; en/es keep "New subscription"/"Nueva suscripción"); bundles "تجديد / إلغاء / أرشفة / استرجاع الحزمة", "إضافة طالب", "تعديل / حفظ الملاحظات", "إنشاء الحزمة", "فتح الحزمة", "إضافة دورة", "حذف الدورة/الطالب {{n}}", "إزالة {{name}}"; studyGroups "تعديل {{name}}", "إضافة", "إضافة {{name}}", "إزالة {{name}}"; trials "فتح الحصة", "اختيار {{name}}"; availability "إضافة فترة ليوم {{day}}", "إضافة فترة". ("فكّ الحزمة" is already a verbal noun.) Regression test: `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m06.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1094".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): AR buttons are verbal nouns throughout — sub 111 "فتح التجديد / تعديل / إلغاء الاشتراك / إضافة مواعيد / إضافة تجميد / إيقاف / استئناف / حذف"; bundle "تجديد / تجميد / إلغاء / فكّ الحزمة", "تعديل الملاحظات"; lists "إضافة اشتراك", "إضافة جدول", "إضافة مجموعة دراسية"; trial "فتح الحصة"; hints stay imperative per D9. Before `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-049-subscriptions_111.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-049-bundles_2.png`; after `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-sub111-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1092-1093-1094-bundle2-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-subs-list-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-schedules-ar-1440.png`. ## ETQAN-QA-1095: A stopped slot is a solid red "موعد متوقف" pill on Weekly schedules but a neutral grey "متوقف" on the subscription page; period range wraps with a leading "–"
- **Feature:** M06 `SchedulesList` status badge + progress column vs `SlotsPanel`. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M06 sweep (M06-R3-052); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01 (period wrap also noted as a gate-1 observation).
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin AR 1440; sub 111 (QA5 Bulk 05, 2026/11/01–2026/12/02) with the Thursday slot stopped.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/scheduling/schedules` → row "QA5 Bulk 05" (Monday only). 2. `/app/scheduling/subscriptions/111` → المواعيد الأسبوعية.
- **Expected:** The same state uses the same badge tone everywhere (a stopped slot is informational, not an error); the period range stays on one line or wraps after the dash.
- **Actual:** List: green "نشط" plus solid red "موعد متوقف" (reads like an error); subscription page: soft grey "متوقف". Progress column on every row wraps "– 2026/11/01" / "2026/12/02" with the dash leading the line while the المواعيد column has free space.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-052-schedules.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/triage/t3-052-sub111-slots.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/sweep/v-schedules-ar-1440.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Fix: `dashboard/src/features/scheduling/SchedulesList.tsx` — the "موعد متوقف" pill uses the neutral tone (grey, like "متوقف" in `SlotsPanel.tsx`) instead of the error-red `warning`; each period date is one isolated, unbreakable piece (`wholeDay`: no-break spaces + FSI/PDI) and `schedules.period` glues the dash to the start date ("{{from}}\u00a0– {{to}}", ar/en), so the range wraps only after "–", never with the dash leading a line (also benefits the add-schedule dialog). Regression test: `SchedulesList.test.tsx` "shows a stopped slot as a neutral pill and keeps each date whole (ETQAN-QA-1095)". Smoke shot: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix-a3/a3c3-schedules-ar-1440.png`.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): Weekly schedules AR 1440 "موعد متوقف" and EN dark "1 slot stopped" are neutral grey pills; period ranges wrap only after the dash ("2026/11/01 –" / "2026/12/02"), each date whole. Before `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-before-052-schedules.png`; after `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1095-schedules-ar-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M06/fix/g3-after-1095-schedules-en-1440-dark.png`. Regression test passes (gate3-vitest.log).

## ETQAN-QA-1651: Academy change page lets an operator pick "Being created"/"Creation failed" or force "Active" on an unbuilt academy: the save builds the schema inside the request (30+ s) and leaves an "Active" academy with no admin, a pending domain and every API 404
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P2. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-003); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN 1440; an academy stuck in Being created (QA R3 A, id 27, before Agent 1's edit).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/27/change/`. 2. Status dropdown: options are Active / Suspended / Being created / Creation failed. 3. Pick Active, Save and continue editing. 4. Open `http://qa-r3-a.etqan.localhost/app/login`.
- **Expected:** Build states (Being created, Creation failed) are not selectable by hand and an unbuilt academy can't be made Active from the form; a change-page save never runs migrations.
- **Actual:** Status offers all four values (`#id_status` options "Active|Suspended|Being created|Creation failed"). Saving Active ran all tenant migrations in the request (schema `academy_qa_r3_a` now exists). The academy is "Active" (now suspended) yet has 0 users (`academy_qa_r3_a.identity_user` count 0), its domain `qa-r3-a.etqan.localhost` is still `pending`, the login shows the raw host name and 404s `/api/v1/identity/me/`, `/site/branding/`, `/identity/sign-in-options/`, `/translations/`.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s007-crop-top.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s009-r3a-host.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t003-r3a-status-field.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t003-r3a-host.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/services.py` `BUILT`/`UNBUILT`/`is_built`; `backend/etqan/tenants/admin.py`: the change form's Status offers only Active/Suspended; on a Being created / Creation failed academy Status is read-only with a "Build" note; `save_model` on change sets `auto_create_schema=False`, so `TenantMixin.save` never builds a schema inside the request (decision D-M01-3; data of ids 27/28 left for the owner).
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_a_built_academys_status_offers_only_active_and_suspended, test_saving_an_unbuilt_academy_never_builds_it
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01; retested in the browser, after shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1651-*` / `g2-1651-*`; pytest 156 passed (logs/M01/gate2/pytest.log); vitest login 13/13 for 1677).

## ETQAN-QA-1653: Adding an academy fails ("Creation failed") whenever the template schema is missing or stale: provisioning rebuilds the template inside the task's 60 s soft time limit, times out, and the template is never kept
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P2. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-005); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** Local stack; no `academy_template` schema (checked in Postgres 2026-11-01); celery default `CELERY_TASK_SOFT_TIME_LIMIT = 60`.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. As ops add an academy (Agent 1: QA R3 B, `qa-r3-b`). 2. Wait a minute, open it.
- **Expected:** The academy is built. Building the template (all ~176 tenant migrations) is not capped by the 60 s per-task default, or happens outside the operator's academy task, and once built it is kept.
- **Actual:** Worker: `provision_academy … Soft time limit (60s) exceeded` → `SoftTimeLimitExceeded` raised from `services.provision_academy` line 199 (`ensure_template()`); QA R3 B is "Creation failed"; afterwards no `academy_template` schema exists, so every later add repeats the full build and fails the same way. `provision_academy` task has no own `soft_time_limit` (other long tasks set 240–3000 s).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s013-r3b-created.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s017-crop.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t005-r3b-change.png`, `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M01/triage-worker.log`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/tasks.py` `provision_academy` gets `soft_time_limit=30 min`, `time_limit=35 min` (the template build migrates every tenant app); `services.ensure_template` always removes its throwaway row (try/finally), so a failed build leaves no row and the next run rebuilds the stale schema.
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_building_an_academy_has_room_for_the_template, test_the_template_row_is_never_active_and_always_goes
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01; retested in the browser, after shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1653-*` / `g2-1653-*`; pytest 156 passed (logs/M01/gate2/pytest.log); vitest login 13/13 for 1677). Template build ran 178 s under the new limits (1800/2100 s) and kept `academy_template` (logs/M01/gate1-ensure-template.log); no academy_template row left, no per-academy failures in the worker log for the last hour.

## ETQAN-QA-1654: A "Creation failed" academy has no way out in the console: no reason, no retry, delete is 403 even for the superuser, and its subdomain stays taken for good
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-006); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN 1440; QA R3 B (id 28, never built).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/28/change/`. 2. Look for a reason / retry. 3. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/28/delete/`. 4. Add an academy with subdomain `qa-r3-b`.
- **Expected:** The spec (2026-10-29, non-goals) says a failed academy is retried by "re-add it after deleting the row": so a never-built (failed, no schema) academy can be deleted (or retried), and the page says it failed.
- **Actual:** Only the Status select shows "Creation failed"; delete returns 403 "You don't have access to this page" (`has_delete_permission` False for every academy); re-adding says "This subdomain is already taken." The only control on offer is forcing Status to Active, which gives ETQAN-QA-1651's broken academy.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s017-crop.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s019-r3b-delete.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t006-r3b-delete.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/services.py` `may_delete` (failed and no schema); `AcademyAdmin.has_delete_permission` allows Delete only for such a row (no bulk delete), `DomainAdmin.has_delete_permission` lets its pending subdomain go with it, so the subdomain is free to add again; read-only "Build" line explains the failure and the way out (decision D-M01-2; stored reason + Retry is a proposal there).
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_only_a_failed_academy_with_nothing_built_may_be_deleted
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01; retested in the browser, after shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1654-*` / `g2-1654-*`; pytest 156 passed (logs/M01/gate2/pytest.log); vitest login 13/13 for 1677). Note: QA R3 B itself still can't be deleted because Agent 1's pre-fix voided invoice ETQ-2026-10-0003 protects it (`g1654-after-delete-confirm.png`); after QA-1665 a never-built academy can no longer get an invoice, so this is legacy QA data, not a product gap.

## ETQAN-QA-1655: While the template is being built it is an "active" academy row: background jobs (notifications.scan) loop over it and fail, and list totals count it
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-007); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** Local stack during an academy build (Agent 1, R3-005).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Add an academy while no template exists. 2. Watch `tenants_academy` and the worker log during the build.
- **Expected:** The template row is never seen by `for_each_academy` jobs or the console counts.
- **Actual:** `ensure_template` creates `Academy(schema_name='academy_template', name='Academy template', subdomain=None)` with the default status `active`; the worker logged `notifications.scan failed for academy academy_template` (relation `notifications_notificationsetting` does not exist) and the filtered list said "1 result (22 total)" while 21 academies were listed.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s014-filter-being-created.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s015-template-search.png`, `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M01/triage-worker.log`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/services.py` `ensure_template` creates its row as `provisioning` (so `for_each_academy`, which runs only `active`, never enters it) and deletes it in `finally`; `services.academies()` and `AcademyAdmin.get_queryset` exclude `TENANT_BASE_SCHEMA`, so list totals and pickers never count it.
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_the_template_row_is_never_active_and_always_goes
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01; retested in the browser, after shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1655-*` / `g2-1655-*`; pytest 156 passed (logs/M01/gate2/pytest.log); vitest login 13/13 for 1677). After shot: qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/1655-after-final.png

## ETQAN-QA-1656: Suspend / Reactivate apply to academies that were never built: a "Creation failed" academy becomes "Active" with no schema, and background jobs then fail on it every minute
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P2. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-008); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN 1440; QA R3 B (failed, no schema).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Academies, search `qa-r3-b`, tick it. 2. Action "Reactivate selected academies", Run (Agent 1 also clicked Yes). 3. Open `http://qa-r3-b.etqan.localhost/app/login`.
- **Expected:** Suspend/Reactivate skip academies that are not built (Being created / Creation failed) with a message such as "QA R3 B was never built; nothing changed."
- **Actual:** The confirm page offers "Reactivate 1 academy? أكاديمية الإتقان QA R3 B — qa-r3-b · now Suspended"; Agent 1's Yes made it **Active** (`services.set_status` updates any non-public row). From then the worker logged `notifications.scan failed for academy academy_qa_r3_b`, `scheduling.provision_meetings failed …`, `consultations.cancel_unpaid failed …` every minute; its login loads with the host name and every API 404s.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s022-reactivate-failed.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s023-r3b-host.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t008-reactivate-failed-confirm.png`, `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M01/triage-worker.log`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/services.py` `set_status` changes only built academies (`status__in=BUILT`); `AcademyAdmin._skip_unbuilt` names each unbuilt academy ("Skipped …: it was never built (Creation failed); nothing changed.") and leaves it out of the confirm page; no confirm page when none is left.
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_suspend_and_reactivate_leave_an_unbuilt_academy_alone
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01; retested in the browser, after shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1656-*` / `g2-1656-*`; pytest 156 passed (logs/M01/gate2/pytest.log); vitest login 13/13 for 1677).

- **Expected:** Hosts wrap only at dots/hyphens (or truncate with a title); a host name is never capitalised; an Etqan subdomain isn't told to add a CNAME.
- **Actual:** "premium.etqan.localh/ost", "www.qa-r3-/a.example.test" wraps; message "Qa-r3-a.etqan.localhost: resolves to nothing, expected sites.etqan.localhost." (the admin message template's `capfirst`). Related to ETQAN-QA-809's break-anywhere fix.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s040-domains.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s041-domain-checkdns.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t014-domains-list.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t014-checkdns-capital.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `backend/etqan/tenants/admin.py`: the list's Domain column is `host` with `<wbr>` after each dot/hyphen (`_breakable_host`), and the console CSS no longer breaks anywhere; Check DNS messages start with a word ("Activated …", "Not activated: … resolves to …", "Skipped …") so `capfirst` never touches the host; an Etqan subdomain is skipped with "it is the academy's Etqan subdomain" instead of a CNAME request.
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_hosts_break_only_after_dots_and_hyphens, test_check_dns_skips_an_etqan_subdomain_without_capitalising_it; `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_domain_admin.py` wording updated
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, after gate cycle 1):** `backend/etqan/tenants/admin.py` `_host_parts`: a label longer than 20 characters also gets a `<wbr>` every 20 characters (fallback after the dot/hyphen breaks), so the 63-character `aaaa…a` label can no longer widen the Domains list; `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html`: list headers and Django's `nowrap` date cells may wrap (`body #changelist table thead th, body #result_list td.nowrap`), so Status / Is primary / Is custom / Verified at fit at 1440. Regression test: `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_a_very_long_host_label_still_gets_breaks. Agent 2 to re-check the Domains list at 1440.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): Domains list at 1440 EN fits: `.results` 791 = table 791, the 63-character label host breaks every 20 characters, Status / Is primary / Is custom / Verified at all visible (`qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g3-1662-domains-1440.png`); Check DNS message part VERIFIED at cycle 1. Tests: pytest -p no:cacheprovider 4 files 37 passed (tenants/etqan_billing test_admin_round3_qa, test_domain_admin, test_admin_layout_qa; logs/M01/gate3/pytest.log). Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): host breaks are fixed, but the Domains list at 1440 now overflows: `.results` 791 px holds a 1161 px table because the 63-character label host `aaaa…a.bbbb…b.cccc…c.dddd…d.co` (QA Tmp One) can only break at dots, so the Domain column is 533 px and STATUS / IS PRIMARY / IS CUSTOM / VERIFIED AT are cut off at the box edge ("Pen DNS"). Before the fix the list fitted. Needs a fallback break for long labels (e.g. `overflow-wrap:anywhere` only inside a label longer than ~20 chars, or `<wbr>` every 20 chars inside a label). Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g1662-after-domains-full.png`, `g2-1662-domains-1440.png`; the Check DNS message part (`g1662-after-checkdns.png`) is VERIFIED.

## ETQAN-QA-1674: Console at tablet widths: the 300 px nav and the filter panel both stay; at 768 the results box is 159 px (search 34 px, only Name visible), at 1024 it is 415 px for a 741 px table
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-027 + 028); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN 768x1024 and 1024x768.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/` at 768 and at 1024.
- **Expected:** At tablet width the nav collapses or the filter moves above/below, so the list fits; inputs keep a usable width.
- **Actual:** 768: `.results` 159/741, search 34 px, "Copy / features / from" over three lines, action selects under the Filter panel. 1024: 415/741, "PLA…" cut, Currency and Created at hidden.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s112-768x1024-academies.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s112-1024x768-academies.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t027-academies-768x1024.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t027-academies-1024x768.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Console CSS `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html` (decision D-M01-4): below 1100 px the side menu is hidden and the filter sits under the list at full width; the search box keeps a usable width.
- **Regression test:** No unit test (CSS); `test_admin_round3_qa.py` checks the page still renders. Agent 2 to check at 768/1024.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, after gate cycle 1):** root cause: Django's `nav_sidebar.css` (`.main.shifted > #nav-sidebar + .content { max-width: calc(100% - 299px) }`) and `changelists.css` (`:has(#changelist-filter) > div { max-width: calc(100% - 270px) }`, `#changelist-filter { flex: 0 0 240px }`) load after the console's style block and won on equal/higher specificity. `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html`: the ≤1100 px rules now carry a `body` prefix (incl. the `.shifted` rule), the form container stretches its children, and cells may break a long slug (`overflow-wrap:anywhere` on list cells; hosts keep their `<wbr>` breaks). Measured by Agent 3 (not a verification): `.results` = table width at 768 (728/728) and 1024 (984/984) on academies, domains, invoices, users, platform accounts. Regression test: `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_the_console_list_styles_beat_djangos_own_sheets. Agent 2 to re-check at 768/1024.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, after gate cycle 2):** root cause of the split words: `overflow-wrap:anywhere` lowers each cell's min-content to one letter, so the table algorithm shrank the short columns to slivers. `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html`: below 1100 px list cells use `overflow-wrap:break-word` (never narrows a column; only a single word wider than the whole box may break) and headers `overflow-wrap:normal` ("PERIOD" no longer splits beside its sort arrows); the phone-card rule uses `break-word` too; between 768 and 1100 px the timestamp columns (Created at, Verified at) step aside (decision D-M01-8; still on the record page and the phone cards); a `.nobreak` span keeps a date whole. `backend/etqan/etqan_billing/admin.py` `key_date`: each date is wrapped in `<span class="nobreak">` ("Voided 2026-11-/01" wrapped at the hyphen before). Diagnosis shots by Agent 3 (not a verification): `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/a3-1674-*` (domains 768/1024, academies/invoices/users 768). Regression tests: `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_console_lists_never_split_a_word_at_tablet_widths; `backend/etqan/etqan_billing/tests/test_admin_layout_qa.py` (nobreak date, '-' when no date); `etqan_billing/tests/test_admin.py` test_etqan_emails_issued_invoices_again updated for the span. pytest -p no:cacheprovider 4 files 52 passed (round-3/logs/M01/fix3/pytest.log). Agent 2 to re-check 768/1024 (domains, academies, invoices, users, platform accounts).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): ops EN, light, 768x1024 and 1024x768 on Domains, Academies, Etqan invoices, Users, Platform accounts: `.results` = table (728/728 at 768, 984/984 at 1024), page width = viewport, side menu hidden, filter under the list, search usable; a per-character line-break check over every visible cell and header found no word split mid-word (Disabled, Pending DNS, Suspended, CURRENCY, PERIOD, IS PRIMARY, ID all whole; dates whole). Regression checks: Domains 1440 (table 791 = box, Verified at shown), invoices 375 phone cards clean, Academies 768 dark clean. Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g4-1674-*` (before: `g3-1674-*`). Tests: pytest -p no:cacheprovider tenants test_admin_round3_qa, etqan_billing test_admin_layout_qa/test_admin/test_admin_round3_qa 52 passed; ruff check/format clean (`round-3/logs/M01/gate4/pytest.log`). Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2, gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): the squeeze is gone (`.results` = table = 728 at 768 and 984 at 1024 on academies, invoices, domains, users, platform accounts; nav hidden, filter under the list, search 385 px), but the new `overflow-wrap:anywhere` on every list cell and header now splits ordinary words mid-word: 768 Domains "Disa/bled", "Pen/ding DNS", "Etqa/n Prem/ium Acad/emy", "Not built (cre/atio/n faile/d)", headers "TENA/NT", "IS PRI/MA/RY", "VERIF/IED AT"; 768 Academies "Suspende/d", "CURRE/NCY"; 768 Invoices "PERIO/D", "STATU/S"; 768 Users "I/D"; and still at 1024 Domains "Disabl/ed", "Pendin/g DNS", "IS CUS/TO/M". The Domain column keeps a wide max-content while the short columns shrink to slivers. Suggested: drop `anywhere` from headers and short-word cells (status, tenant, flags), break only slug/host/email values at their own <wbr>/hyphen points (as 1662 does), and/or hide low-value columns (Created at, Verified at, Plan label) below 1100 px. Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g3-1674-tenants-domain-768x1024.png`, `g3-1674-tenants-domain-1024x768.png`, `g3-1674-tenants-academy-768x1024.png`, `g3-1674-etqan_billing-etqaninvoice-768x1024.png`, `g3-1674-identity-user-768x1024.png`. Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): the side menu is gone and the filter moves under the list, but the list is still squeezed: at 768x1024 `.results` is 159 px inside a 429 px `.changelist-form-container` inside a 469 px `#content-start` (page is 768), so only Name shows and invoice numbers are cut ("ETQ-2026-11-00"); at 1024x768 the academies table is cut after STATUS ("PLA…"). Container chain at 768: results 159 < changelist-form 159 < div 159 < changelist-form-container 429 (flex column) < content 469 < main 768 (flex row). Shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g2-167x-after-tenants-academy-768x1024.png`, `g2-167x-after-tenants-academy-1024x768.png`, `g2-167x-after-etqan_billing-etqaninvoice-768x1024.png`.

## ETQAN-QA-1675: Console on a phone (375): lists stay wide tables in a sideways box (academies 741 px in 345 px), invoices show only Number and half of Academy, and "Copy features from" shrinks to a 12 px sliver
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 (M01-R3-029); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN/AR 375x812.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/` and `/admin/etqan_billing/etqaninvoice/` at 375.
- **Expected:** Rows readable without sideways scrolling (cards or name+status); action inputs usable; filters reachable.
- **Actual:** Academies `.results` 345/741, Status cut; `copy_from` select 12 px wide; invoices cut after Academy; filters not on the first screen.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s110-375-tenants_academy_.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s111-375-ar-academies.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/s110-375-etqan_billing_etqaninvoice_.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t027-academies-375x812.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t029-invoices-375.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Console CSS + script in `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html` (decision D-M01-4): below 768 px each list row is a card with "Column: value" lines (labels copied from the header), action selects keep min 10rem; the Copy features picker shows only for its action (QA-1664).
- **Regression test:** No unit test (CSS); Agent 2 to check at 375 EN/AR.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, after gate cycle 1):** `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html` card-label script reads the header's `.text` (column name) instead of the whole `th`, so the `.sortoptions` priority digit no longer leaks into the labels ("Number:", "Period:" instead of "2 Number:", "1 Period:"). Regression test: `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py` test_the_console_list_styles_beat_djangos_own_sheets (checks the `.text` lookup). Agent 2 to re-check invoices at 375 sorted by two columns.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): at 375 EN the invoice cards read "Number:", "Academy:", "Period:", "Status:", "Total:", "Dates:" with no sort digit while the list is sorted by two columns; academies and domains cards clean, page width 375 (no sideways scroll) (`qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g3-1675-etqan_billing-etqaninvoice-375.png`, `g3-1675-tenants-domain-375.png`, `g3-1675-tenants-academy-375.png`). Tests: pytest -p no:cacheprovider 4 files 37 passed (tenants/etqan_billing test_admin_round3_qa, test_domain_admin, test_admin_layout_qa; logs/M01/gate3/pytest.log). Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2, gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): phone cards work for Academies (no sideways scroll, labels "Name:", "Status:" …, `g2-167x-after-tenants-academy-375x812.png`), but on Etqan invoices the card labels copy the header's sort-priority digits: "2 Number:", "1 Period:" (`qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/fix/g2-167x-after-etqan_billing-etqaninvoice-375x812.png`). The label script should read the header's link/text without `.sortpriority` (e.g. `th .text a` or `th .text`).

- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 4 / sweep gate, 2026-11-01): markup `Installable app (desktop and mobile) (U+2068…U+2069)`; outer brackets at both ends, inner pair inside the gloss; Zoom/Google glosses now read in Arabic order; light+dark 1440 (fix/g5-1679-installable-1440.png, -dark, -zoom). ## ETQAN-QA-1682: Lists at 1440: date-time cells break between the time and "a.m./p.m." ("Oct. 17, 2026, 6:27 / p.m.") on Academies "Created at" and Users "Date joined"
- **Feature:** M01 Etqan staff console. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), `http://etqan.localhost/admin/`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M01 sweep (M01-R3-037); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Side effect of the ETQAN-QA-1662 list CSS (date cells may wrap); D-M01-8 says a date stays whole.
- **Preconditions:** ops EN 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/admin/tenants/academy/`. 2. Open `/admin/identity/user/`.
- **Expected:** The time and its "a.m./p.m." stay together (ideally the whole date-time on one line, as the invoice Dates column's `.nobreak`).
- **Actual:** Every row ends with a lone "p.m."/"a.m." on a second line; measured `td.field-created_at` / `td.field-date_joined` height 49 px on every row ("Oct. 12, 2026, 4:56 / p.m.", "Oct. 18, 2026, 12:06 / a.m."), so each row is two lines tall. Domains "Verified at" and Platform accounts "Last test at" use the same cell style.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/sweep/M01-R3-037-time-split-academies-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/sweep/M01-R3-037-time-split-users-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t037-academies-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M01/triage/t037-users-1440.png`
- **Fix:** (Agent 3) keep date-time list cells whole at desktop widths (e.g. `white-space:nowrap` for `td.nowrap`/date fields above 1100 px, or a non-breaking space before a.m./p.m.), without undoing 1662/1674 at 768/1024.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, sweep):** `backend/etqan/templates/admin/base_site.html`: `td.nowrap` (Django's date-time cells) wraps only inside `@media (max-width:1100px)`; above 1100 px Django's nowrap holds, so "Oct. 17, 2026, 6:27 p.m." stays on one line. 768/1024 behaviour of 1662/1674 unchanged. Measured (diagnosis): at 1440 Academies/Domains/Users table 791 px in a 791 px box, Platform accounts 1061/1061, date cells 33 px (one line) (`screens/r3/M01/fix/a3-r3s-*-1440.png`).
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/tenants/tests/test_admin_round3_qa.py`::test_console_sweep_styles (no td.nowrap rule outside the tablet media query). pytest -p no:cacheprovider 3 files 44 passed (`qa/manual/round-3/logs/M01/fix3/pytest-sweep.log`).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 4 / sweep gate, 2026-11-01): 1440: Academies/Users/Domains/Platform accounts date cells white-space nowrap, no date text on two lines (per-cell line check), tables fit their box (791/791, 1061/1061); 768/1024 Academies still table = box, no regression of 1674 (fix/g5-1682-*). Tests: pytest -p no:cacheprovider tenants test_admin_round3_qa + test_admin_features + etqan_billing test_admin_console_qa 44 passed (`qa/manual/round-3/logs/M01/gate5/pytest.log`).

## ETQAN-QA-1610: Receipt email: Arabic block says "مقابل: Consultation CR-000013" and "EGP 99.99"; the English block is laid out RTL (".Thank you. We received your payment")
- **Feature:** M16 payment receipt email for a visitor consultation / payment link. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** translation. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3), academy `qa`, Mailpit. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M16 (M16-R3-011); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01 (Mailpit message "[Etqan QA Academy] Payment receipt / إيصال دفع" to `m16r3-visitor@qa.etqan.test`).
- **Preconditions:** consultation booked in Arabic and paid with the SIMULATOR.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open the receipt in Mailpit (HTML view).
- **Expected:** Arabic block fully Arabic ("مقابل: استشارة CR-000013", "99.99 ج.م."), English block LTR, Arabic first for an Arabic booking; booking email names the teacher and a readable time.
- **Actual:** English first and right-aligned with flipped periods; Arabic lines contain "Consultation" and "EGP"; dates "2026-11-01"; the booking email shows "2026-11-02 20:30 (Africa/Cairo)" with no teacher.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M16/M16-R3-receipt-email.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M16/triage/t011-receipt-email.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** New `backend/etqan/platform/wording.py` (Arabic currency signs and zone names moved here from `notifications/text.py`, `money_text`, `day_text` "1 نوفمبر 2026", `time_text`, Unicode `isolate`). `billing/services/receipts.py`: the reader's language first, Arabic block fully Arabic ("مقابل: استشارة CR-000013", "99.99 ج.م.", Arabic month), the other language's lines isolated so they read in their own direction. `consultations/services/notices.py`: the booking email names the teacher and the time as "2 نوفمبر 2026، 20:30 (القاهرة)", booking language first.
- **Regression test:** `backend/etqan/platform/tests/test_wording.py`; `billing/tests/test_receipts.py::test_the_readers_language_comes_first…`; `consultations/tests/test_purpose_complete.py::test_the_booking_email_names_the_teacher_and_reads_the_time` (+ updated visitor-payment test).
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, cycle 2):** link: `consultations/services/notices.py` puts the manage link on a line of its own after "Manage your booking:" / "إدارة الحجز:", and `platform/wording.py::isolate` leaves a bare link un-isolated, so no U+2069 is glued to the URL (text or `urlize` href). Direction: `site/emails.py::_body_blocks` splits the body at blank lines and gives a block whose lines are all isolated (LRI/RLI) its own `dir`/`lang`; `templates/email/layout.html` renders each block as its own `div` (pre-line, `text-align:start`, one-line gap), so the English block of an Arabic email is laid out LTR (and vice versa). Emails rendered without `blocks` (Etqan billing) fall back to the old single body.
- **Regression test (cycle 2):** `site/tests/test_emails.py::test_the_other_language_block_has_its_own_direction`; `platform/tests/test_wording.py::test_isolate_leaves_a_bare_link_alone`; `consultations/tests/test_purpose_complete.py::test_the_booking_email_names_the_teacher_and_reads_the_time` (link on its own line in both blocks, no PDI after it). pytest site emails + wording + purpose_complete + receipts + etqan_billing tasks pass; ruff + lint-imports clean.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01): CR-000018 booked AR and paid with the SIMULATOR (m16r3g-gate@qa.etqan.test). Booking email: manage link on its own line in both blocks, no U+2069 in any href or after the URL in the text part; the English link opens the booking ("M05 Sweep consult / CR-000018 / Under review", no 404). The English block is a `div dir=ltr lang=en` (computed ltr/start) laid out left-aligned in both the booking email and the receipt; Arabic block first and fully Arabic ("مقابل: استشارة CR-000018", "99.99 ج.م.", "1 نوفمبر 2026"). Evidence `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g2-after-booking-email.png`, `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g2-after-receipt.png` (tokens blurred), `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g2-en-manage-link-ok.png`. Tests: pytest test_emails, test_wording, test_purpose_complete, test_receipts 47 passed (`-p no:cacheprovider`, evidence/r3/M16/gate-2/pytest.txt). Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): receipt Arabic block is fully Arabic and first ("مقابل: استشارة CR-000017", "99.99 ج.م.", "1 نوفمبر 2026"); booking email names the teacher and "7 نوفمبر 2026، 19:00 (القاهرة)". REGRESSION: the isolate wrapping puts U+2069 right after the URL in the English "Manage your booking:" line, so the HTML link's href ends in `%E2%81%A9` (and the plain-text URL is followed by the PDI): opening it shows "This booking link is not valid." (404 on `/api/v1/consultations/public/manage/…/`). Also the English block is still right-aligned inside the RTL cell (expected LTR). Evidence `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g-after-receipt.png`, `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g-after-booking-email.png` (tokens blurred), `fix/ETQAN-QA-1610-g-en-manage-link-broken.png` (Mailpit message to m16r3g-gate@qa.etqan.test, CR-000017). Fix hint: keep links out of the isolate (close the isolate before the URL) and give the other-language block its own `dir`/alignment.

## ETQAN-QA-1612: No favicon on the public site (and `/favicon.ico` 404), a blank tab icon in the dashboard, and a plain thin "E" PWA icon whose maskable version is identical
- **Feature:** M16 site `<head>` (`marketing` layout), dashboard `index.html`, `/api/v1/devices/icons/*` (B11 manifest). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** no.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3), academy `qa` (no favicon uploaded). **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M16 (M16-R3-013); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** academy without `favicon_url`.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `curl /ar/` and read `<head>`. 2. `GET /favicon.ico`. 3. `curl /app/` head. 4. `GET /api/v1/devices/manifest.webmanifest` and its 512 / maskable-512 icons.
- **Expected:** A default icon (the generated academy icon) on the site and dashboard when no favicon is set, plus `theme-color`/`apple-touch-icon`; a designed PWA icon; the maskable icon with safe-zone padding; manifest `theme_color` matching the site primary.
- **Actual:** Site head has no `<link rel="icon">` or theme-color; `/favicon.ico` → 404 HTML; dashboard `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`; 512 and maskable icons are byte-identical thin white "E" on flat green; manifest `theme_color` #146A51 vs site primary #0E7C66.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M16/M16-R3-pwa-icon-512.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M16/triage/t013-pwa-icons.png` (512 and maskable side by side)
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** Site: `marketing/src/lib/favicon.ts` (new; initial on the academy colour, escaped), `Layout.astro` (`<link rel=icon>` fallback + `theme-color`), `marketing/src/pages/favicon.ico.ts` (redirect to the uploaded favicon, else the SVG tile; no 404). Dashboard: `dashboard/src/features/branding/apply.ts` `letterIcon` instead of the blank `data:,`. PWA: `backend/etqan/devices/icons.py` draws a ring + bold initial sized to the kind's share, so the maskable icon keeps to the safe zone and differs from the 512 one. Manifest `theme_color` left as the app's colour (D-M16-2).
- **Regression test:** `marketing/test/round3-m16.test.ts` "tab icon (ETQAN-QA-1612)"; `dashboard/src/features/branding/apply.test.ts` "shows the academy's initial…"; `backend/etqan/devices/tests/test_icons.py::test_letter_icon_is_a_seal_and_maskable_is_drawn_smaller`.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): site `<link rel=icon>` SVG tile + theme-color, /favicon.ico 200, dashboard icon set at runtime; PWA 512 = ring + bold E, maskable smaller inside safe zone, bytes differ (fix/ETQAN-QA-1612-g-after-pwa-512.png, -maskable-512.png). Note: icons are cached 1 day per branding timestamp, so the old drawing was served until Agent 2 cleared the qa academy's 3 cached icon keys; other academies refresh within ICON_TTL. tests: marketing vitest 4 files/80 pass; dashboard vitest 9 files/129 pass; backend pytest 6 files/97 pass.

## ETQAN-QA-1361: System status: double-clicking "طابق الاشتراكات الآن" sends two runs; the second is refused (409) with a red "هناك تشغيل قيد التنفيذ بالفعل." toast
- **Feature:** M12 System status (`/app/settings/system-status`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend/dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa` (`qaother` where noted), Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M12 (M12-R3-012); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin AR 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/settings/system-status`. 2. Double-click "طابق الاشتراكات الآن".
- **Expected:** Button disabled after the first click (pending state); one run, no error; the run list refreshes while it is pending.
- **Actual:** Two POSTs to `/api/v1/system-status/runs/`; the second returns 409 and shows the red toast while the first run sits "في الانتظار" (it finished later as "تم").
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/M12-R3-012-reconcile-double.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/triage/t012-reconcile-dblclick.png`
- **Notes:** Console: `409 POST /api/v1/system-status/runs/`. Repro created one extra reconcile run (0 changes).
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/systemstatus/SystemStatusPage.tsx`: a synchronous `useRef` guard sends one run per click burst (released on settle); a 409 `run_open` is a plain notice, not a red error; the button carries `aria-busy` while sending.
- **Regression test:** `SystemStatusPage.test.tsx` "sends one run on a double click".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 1, 2026-11-01): double-click on "طابق الاشتراكات الآن": one new run (2:10 م, في الانتظار), no 409, no console error, no red toast, button shown busy. After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/fix/1361-1362-1364-after-sysstatus-dblclick.png; before shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/fix/*1361*-before-*`. Regression tests pass (evidence/r3/M12/gate-1/).

## ETQAN-QA-1363: Cards with a divided header have 40 px between the divider and the content but 24 px under it (Integrations, Etqan billing, sign-in, gateways) — the ETQAN-QA-1251 fix only covers cards without a header
- **Feature:** Shared `dashboard/src/ui/card.tsx` (seen on M12 Integrations, Etqan billing). **Severity:** P4. **Type:** spacing/icon. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend/dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa` (`qaother` where noted), Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M12 (M12-R3-014); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin AR 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/settings/integrations` and `/app/settings/etqan-billing`. 2. Measure the card body.
- **Expected:** Equal space above and below the card body content.
- **Actual:** Card padding 24/24, header pb 16, `card-content` pt 16 / pb 0 plus the card's 24 px gap: header divider → first line 40 px, last line → card bottom 25 px (measured on all integration cards and the Etqan billing usage card).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/M12-R3-014-card-padding-integrations.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/M12-R3-014b-card-padding-ebilling.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/triage/t014-integrations-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/triage/t014b-ebilling.png`

- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/ui/card.tsx`: a `CardContent` right after a divided header (`.border-b`) drops its own top padding (`[&>[data-slot=card-header].border-b+[data-slot=card-content]]:pt-0`), so the space under the divider is the card's 24px gap, equal to the 24px under the body, on every card app-wide.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/ui/card.test.tsx` "drops the content's own top padding under a divided header".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate, round 3 cycle 1, 2026-11-01): measured divider->first line / last line->card bottom: integrations 24/25 on all five cards, Etqan billing usage card 24/25. After: qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/fix/1363-1366-after-integrations-1440.png, qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/fix/1363-1364-1374-1375-after-ebilling-1440.png; before shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M12/fix/*1363*-before-*`. Regression tests pass (evidence/r3/M12/gate-1/).

- **Expected:** `٥٠` accepted as 50 (Arabic keyboards; the teacher withdrawal form accepts them); `1.234` told "منزلتان عشريتان كحد أقصى".
- **Actual:** Both show red "أدخل مبلغًا أكبر من صفر، مثل 150 أو 150.50." with the "." at the start of the 2nd line. Same wrong reason as ETQAN-QA-1177 (donations), not fixed for the wallet form.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/M15-R3-010-topup-3-decimals.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/M15-R3-010b-topup-arabic-digits.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/triage/t010-topup-3dec.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/triage/t010-topup-arabic-digits.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `features/wallet/schemas.ts` `amountIssue`: reads Arabic-Indic/Persian digits and "٫" (`latinDigits`, as ETQAN-QA-404), and a number with too many decimals returns `billing.errors.decimals{n}` instead of `amountInvalid`. Arabic hints in `billing.errors.*` glue the final full stop to the isolated example with a word joiner (U+2060), so it never wraps alone.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1306"; `features/wallet/schemas.test.ts` updated (1.005 EGP → decimals2, 5.5 JPY → decimals0).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): "٥٠" accepted (no error, Stripe button shown); "1.234" → "استخدم منزلتين عشريتين على الأكثر، مثل 150.50." with the full stop kept with the example (`v1306-1308-topup-arabic50-after.png`, `v1306-topup-3dec-after.png`). Shots in `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/fix/`; vitest `qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` + `StarRating.test.tsx` + `wallet/schemas.test.ts` 57/57 pass (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M15/gate-1/vitest-m15.txt`).

## ETQAN-QA-1329: Invoice page: "ادفع من الرصيد" is inserted a moment after load and pushes "استخدام كود"/"طباعة" ~120 px
- **Feature:** M15 Student & parent portal. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa` (`http://qa.etqan.localhost/app/`), Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M15 (M15-R3-036); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** student `qa-student@` AR 1440x900 (wallet balance 19.00).
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/learning/invoices/11` and watch the action row.
- **Expected:** A stable row (wait for the wallet before rendering the row, or reserve the space).
- **Actual:** `PayFromWallet` returns null until `useStudentWallet` resolves, then renders the button between the primary and "استخدام كود" (Agent 1's shots show 3 then 4 buttons; final state in the triage shot).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/M15-R3-002-pay-total-opens-1egp-invoice.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/M15-R3-011-fee-dialog-alignment.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/triage/t014-invoice-page.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `features/billing/InvoicePage.tsx` takes an `actionsGate` (wraps the whole action row, billing still never imports the wallet); the family route passes `WalletReadyActions` (`features/wallet/PayFromWallet.tsx`), which holds a blank band of the row's height until the wallet is read, so all buttons appear at once.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1329".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): all four action buttons appear in the same frame (polled every 50 ms from load: one state only) (`v1310-1329-invoice11-after.png`). Shots in `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/fix/`; vitest `qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` + `StarRating.test.tsx` + `wallet/schemas.test.ts` 57/57 pass (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M15/gate-1/vitest-m15.txt`).

## ETQAN-QA-1339: EN phone sessions: "Postpone" drops to its own line on postponed rows
- **Feature:** M15 Student & parent portal. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend + dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa` (`http://qa.etqan.localhost/app/`), Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs` (batch, one browser). **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M15 confirmation sweep (M15-R3-046); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Residual of ETQAN-QA-1330.
- **Preconditions:** student `qa-student@` EN 375x812; a session postponed from Nov 5 to Nov 6.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/learning/sessions`.
- **Expected:** The action in the same place on every row (ETQAN-QA-1330), e.g. pills on one line and buttons on the next.
- **Actual:** "Postpone" buttons at x,y = 189,335 / 41,484 / 130,600 / 130,717: on the Nov 6 row the longer pill "Postponed from Nov 5, 2026" pushes "Postpone" alone onto a third line at the start edge. AR at 375 fits on one line, so only EN (and longer pills) show it.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/sweep/p-en-375-sessions.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M15/triage/t046-sessions-en-375.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `features/scheduling/FamilySessions.tsx`: the row's end part is two groups, pills (state, postponed-from, kind, group, substitute) and actions (Join + Postpone). On a phone they stack (`flex-col items-start`), so the actions always start their own line at the start edge on every row whatever the pills' length; from `sm` up they share one row (`sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-end`). Empty groups are hidden (`empty:hidden`).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1339".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, gate cycle 3, 2026-11-01): retested in the browser; before = `screens/r3/M15/fix/g3-1339-*-before.png`, after = g3-1339-sessions-en-375-after.png (full page; every Join/Postpone starts its own line at the start edge) in `screens/r3/M15/fix/`; vitest `qa-round3-m15.test.tsx` 56/56 pass (`qa/manual/evidence/r3/M15/gate-3/vitest.txt`).

## ETQAN-QA-1506: Arabic UI: a homework or template title that starts with Latin ("M11 …", "M14-C …") flips the dialog heading, the Title field and the phone card title to left-to-right; "كلّف به: QA teacher" is awkward
- **Feature:** M11 homework detail dialog, homework phone cards, certificate template edit dialog. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** RTL. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M11 (M11-R3-008); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Side effect of the ETQAN-QA-651 `dir="auto"`, the same class as ETQAN-QA-684 (fixed for library/student cards only).
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 1440x900 and 375x812.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/scheduling/homework` → "فتح" on "M11 عنوان طويل جدا…". 2. Same on "M14-C واجب تأكيد". 3. `/app/people/certificate-templates` → "تعديل القالب" on "M11 قالب شهادة الحفظ". 4. Homework at 375x812.
- **Expected:** Arabic text that only begins with a code stays right-aligned in the Arabic UI (code isolated in `<bdi>`, block in the page direction), as ETQAN-QA-684 does on the library; the teacher meta reads naturally ("المعلّم: QA teacher").
- **Actual:** The 4-line dialog heading is left-aligned while the dialog is right-aligned; the "العنوان" input and "التعليمات" textarea start at the left with "M11" on the left and the full stop moved; the template "العنوان" input does the same; on a phone the card's title block is left-aligned. Meta line "كلّف به: QA teacher" (also seen by the teacher about himself).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/M11-R3-008-hw-dialog-title-ltr.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/s051-tpl-edit-ar.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t008-hw-dialog.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t020-hw-delete-confirm.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t016-tpl-edit.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t024-hw-phone-admin.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `textDir()` (`dashboard/src/lib/bidi.ts`) replaces first-strong `dir="auto"` on the homework dialog title, its Title input, Instructions textarea and read-only instructions, the delete-confirm title (`dashboard/src/features/homework/HomeworkDialog.tsx`), the list/phone-card title (`HomeworkList.tsx`), the template name and its input (`dashboard/src/features/certificates/TemplatesAdmin.tsx`) and the honour title cell (`HonourAdmin.tsx`): "M11 عنوان…" now stays right to left. Meta line `homework.dialog.setBy` is now "بتكليف من {name}".
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3, after gate cycle 1):** root cause of the Title inputs is the shared `dashboard/src/ui/input.tsx`: it always added `[unicode-bidi:plaintext]` (ETQAN-QA-060), which lets the first strong letter override the `dir` attribute. Now `plaintext` is added only when the caller passes no `dir`; with an explicit `dir` (here `textDir()` on the homework `#hw-edit-title` and the template «اسم القالب» input) the value gets `[unicode-bidi:isolate]`, so `dir="rtl"` decides and «M14-C واجب تأكيد» starts at the right. Inputs without `dir` (names, emails, phones) keep the ETQAN-QA-060 behaviour.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/homework/HomeworkDialog.test.tsx` "keeps a title that starts with a code in its own direction (ETQAN-QA-1506)" and the updated ETQAN-QA-651 test; `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m11.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1518/1506"; `dashboard/src/ui/input.test.tsx` "lets an explicit dir decide the value's direction" (asserts no `plaintext` class and the `isolate` class when `dir` is passed). Scoped vitest (`--maxWorkers=1`): input, HomeworkDialog, TemplatesAdmin, qa-round3-m11: 4 files / 58 pass; biome clean.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 2, 2026-11-01). Homework «M14-C واجب تأكيد» `#hw-edit-title`: `dir=rtl`, computed `unicode-bidi: isolate`, value starts at the right at 1440 dark and 375 (`qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/fix/g3-1506-hw-dialog-m14c.png`, `g3-1506-hw-dialog-375.png`, scrollWidth 375); template «اسم القالب» «M11 قالب شهادة الحفظ» likewise (`g3-1506-tpl-edit.png`); an input without `dir` (homework search, «Aisha R.») keeps `plaintext` (ETQAN-QA-060 intact). Tests re-run: `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M11/gate-2/vitest.txt` (input, HomeworkDialog, TemplatesAdmin, qa-round3-m11: 4 files / 58 pass). Earlier: FAILED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). The dialog heading, the Instructions textarea, the phone card title (g2-1522-1506-hw-phone-admin.png) and the delete-confirm title are right to left now, and the meta reads «بتكليف من QA teacher». But the Title inputs still start at the left: on «M14-C واجب تأكيد» the homework `#hw-edit-title` input has `dir="rtl"` yet renders «M14-C واجب تأكيد» left-aligned with M14-C at the left (g2-1506-hw-dialog-m14c.png, g2-1506-hw-title-blurred.png; same on the long M11 title, g2-1506-hw-dialog.png), and the template edit «اسم القالب» input does the same (g2-1514-1506-tpl-edit.png). Cause: the shared `dashboard/src/ui/input.tsx` always adds `[unicode-bidi:plaintext]` (ETQAN-QA-060), and computed `unicode-bidi: plaintext` makes the first strong letter (M) decide the direction, so the `dir` from `textDir()` is ignored; the textarea has no such rule, which is why Instructions is right. Needed: let an explicit `dir` win in the shared Input (e.g. add `[unicode-bidi:plaintext]` only when no `dir` prop is passed, or `unicode-bidi:isolate` when it is), plus a test that asserts the class/computed style, not only the `dir` attribute. Tests re-run: `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M11/gate-1/vitest.txt`.

## ETQAN-QA-1507: Issue certificate: an empty submit flags Student and Course but not the starred "الحصص المكتملة *"; the same hint is given twice; field order differs from the detail dialog; type "فخر" reads oddly
- **Feature:** M11 "إصدار شهادة" dialog. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** functional. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M11 (M11-R3-009); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 1440x900.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/people/certificates` → "إصدار شهادة". 2. Press "إصدار شهادة" with nothing filled. 3. Compare with "فتح" on an existing certificate.
- **Expected:** Every empty required (*) field gets its error, or the field is not starred; one hint; the same field order in both dialogs; a natural label for the fourth type.
- **Actual:** "اختر طالبًا." and "اختر دورة." appear; "الحصص المكتملة *" stays empty with no message. The subtitle "يُملأ عدد الحصص المكتملة بعد اختيار الطالب والدورة." repeats the field helper "يُملأ تلقائيًا من الحصص التي حضرها الطالب، ويمكنك تعديله.". Issue dialog order: photo, message, date; detail dialog: message, date, photo. The type radios read "إتمام / تقدير / فخر / مخصصة" ("فخر" = "pride" as a certificate name).
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/M11-R3-009-cert-issue-sessions-no-error.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t009-cert-issue-empty.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/triage/t003-cert-open-picker.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/features/certificates/IssueCertificateDialog.tsx`: Completed sessions is optional at issue (empty = the server counts attended sessions, `completed_sessions` `required=False`), so it is no longer starred; its one hint is the field's `hint`; the dialog subtitle now says what to do ("اختر الطالب والدورة ونوع الشهادة."); fields run message, date, photo as in the detail dialog. Kind "pride" is "فخر واعتزاز" / "شهادة فخر واعتزاز" (decision D-M11-2).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/features/certificates/IssueCertificateDialog.test.tsx` "marks only what is required, with one hint (ETQAN-QA-1507)" and "describes itself"; `dashboard/src/qa-round3-m11.test.tsx` "ETQAN-QA-1507/1514".
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01). Evidence: `qa/manual/screens/r3/M11/fix/` g2-1507-1502-issue-empty.png (empty submit flags الطالب and الدورة; الحصص المكتملة not starred, one hint; subtitle «اختر الطالب والدورة ونوع الشهادة.»; order message, date, photo as in g2-1502-cert-open.png; «فخر واعتزاز»). Tests re-run: `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M11/gate-1/vitest.txt` (14 files / 188 pass).

## ETQAN-QA-1510: Row delete buttons in the area use three styles: neutral outline "حذف التكريم" on the honour board, solid red "حذف" / "حذف القالب" on library, reports, templates and course content
- **Feature:** M11 honour board, files library, monthly reports, certificate templates, course content. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** UI/layout. **Easy:** yes.

- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M11 (M11-R3-013); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Same class as ETQAN-QA-1093 / 1157 / 1054 (other areas moved row-level triggers to `destructiveOutline`).

Library, reports, templates, content: solid red "حذف" / "حذف القالب" on every row/card. Row labels are short and uniform, "تعديل" / "حذف" with the item in the aria-label (`honour.rowEdit/rowDelete`, `certificates.templates.rowEdit/rowDelete`, `content.rowEdit`); honour "نشر" / "إلغاء النشر" share a min width so the groups line up.

Tests re-run: `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M11/gate-1/vitest.txt` (14 files / 188 pass).

## ETQAN-QA-1482: Typed text (AR): a ")" right after a Latin word is pulled into the Latin isolate, so the brackets of "(عدّلها المكتب M10)" face the same way
- **Feature:** M10 `dashboard/src/lib/bidi.ts` `bidiRuns` (`LATIN_RUN` takes `)` and `]` as trailing punctuation), shown by `components/BidiText.tsx` in chat bubbles, previews, broadcasts, messages and broadcast details. **Severity:** P4. **Type:** RTL. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium (one batched Playwright run). **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M10 sweep (M10-R3-037); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01. Follow-up of ETQAN-QA-1452/1461.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, 1440x900; group "مجموعة حلقة التجويد-M10" has the message "السلام عليكم جميعًا (عدّلها المكتب M10)".
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/chat?c=3`. 2. Look at the message.
- **Expected:** "(عدّلها المكتب M10)" shows as one bracketed phrase, brackets facing each other. A closing bracket whose opener lies outside the Latin run stays outside the isolate.
- **Actual:** DOM `السلام عليكم جميعًا (عدّلها المكتب <bdi dir="ltr">M10)</bdi>`; the ")" inside the LTR isolate is not mirrored while the "(" outside is, so the bubble reads "(عدّلها المكتب (M10" with both brackets the same way.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M10/sweep/w35z-bubble.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M10/triage/t037z-bubble.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M10/triage/t037-chat-bracket.png`
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/lib/bidi.ts` `bidiRuns`: a new `balancedRun` cuts a Latin run before a closing `)`/`]` in its trailing punctuation whose opener is not inside the run, so the bracket stays in the Arabic text and mirrors with its "("; a bracket opened in the run ("f(x)") stays. Applies everywhere `BidiText` is used (chat bubbles, previews, broadcasts, messages, broadcast details).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/components/BidiText.test.tsx` "bidiRuns brackets" (4 cases: "(عدّلها المكتب M10)", "(Zoom).", "f(x)", "Thanks!").

## ETQAN-QA-1588: Phone: the website tab strip doesn't scroll to the active tab, so on most tabs the current one is off-screen
- **Feature:** M13 Website section tabs (`routes/_authed/website.tsx`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3, backend/dashboard `feat/premium-dashboard-ui` working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 1, round 3 M13 confirmation sweep (M13-R3-039); reproduced by Agent 2 on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR and EN, 375x812.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/website/inquiries` directly (also settings, FAQs, ads, redirects, articles, videos, testimonials). 2. Look at the tab strip; measure the `aria-current="page"` tab.
- **Expected:** The one-row scrolling tab bar (QA-717) brings the current tab into view on load, so the highlighted tab is always visible.
- **Actual:** The strip always starts at دليل التجهيز / الهوية / الصفحة الرئيسية / الصفحات (EN Setup guide / Branding / Home page / Pages). The active "الاستفسارات" tab sits at left −141…−54 px (AR) and "Inquiries" at 454…528 px (EN, viewport 375): off-screen. No fade or arrow hints that the strip scrolls.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/M13/M13-R3-039-tabs-active-offscreen-375.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M13/triage/t039-tabs-ar-375-inquiries.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/M13/triage/t039-tabs-en-375-inquiries.png`
- **Notes:** Follow-up of ETQAN-QA-717 (one-row scrolling strip). Scroll the active tab into view (`scrollIntoView({inline:"nearest", block:"nearest"})` on the strip only, not the page) on mount and route change; consider an edge fade.
- **Fix (Agent 3, round 3):** `dashboard/src/routes/_authed/website.tsx`: new `useActiveTabInView()` on the tab strip: on load and on every route change, when the strip actually overflows (phone), the `aria-current="page"` tab is scrolled into view with `scrollIntoView({block:"nearest", inline:"center"})`, so only the strip moves (not the page) and the neighbouring tabs show on both sides as a hint that it scrolls. Desktop (wrapping, no overflow) is untouched.
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/routes/_authed/website.test.tsx` "on a phone (ETQAN-QA-1588)": scrolls the current tab into view (overflowing strip), and leaves a strip that fits alone.
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2, round 3 gate cycle 2 after sweep, 2026-11-01): retested in the browser; shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/M13/fix/` g1588-tabs-ar-375-inquiries, g1588-tabs-en-375-inquiries, g1588-tabs-ar-375-settings (current tab scrolled into view in the strip); tests `qa/manual/round-3/logs/M13/gate-3/vitest.txt` (3 files/37 pass, --maxWorkers=1)

## ETQAN-QA-1700: Website setup guide progress line says "{{minutes}} دقيقة" for every count ("3 دقيقة", "1 دقيقة")
- **Feature:** Website → Setup guide (`dashboard/src/features/website/SetupGuide.tsx`, key `website.setup.progress`). **Severity:** P3. **Type:** translation (plural). **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3 working tree), academy `qa`, Chromium via `qa/manual/tools/step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** Agent 2, translation round 3 review, 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR, any width.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. `/app/website/setup`. 2. Read the progress line under the bar. 3. Finish steps until 3–10 minutes are left (or read the code: `minutes: left`, the sum of the step minutes left, which takes values like 2, 3, 4, 7).
- **Expected:** Correct Arabic plural for the minutes left: "دقيقتان"، "3 دقائق"، "24 دقيقة". The same page already has a full plural set `website.setup.minutes_{zero…other}` used for each step's "4 دقائق".
- **Actual:** "الخطوات المنجزة: 5 من 13 · الوقت المتبقي: 24 دقيقة تقريبًا" is right only for 11+; with 3–10 minutes left it reads "الوقت المتبقي: 4 دقيقة تقريبًا", and "1 دقيقة" / "2 دقيقة" for one and two. Agent 4's rewrite fixed the "{{total}} خطوة" half of this string (group1.md line 165) but kept the fixed "دقيقة".
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/translation/07-website-setup-1440.png`, `qa/manual/screens/r3/translation/21-website-setup-375.png` (24 minutes, correct by chance; also wraps "24 / دقيقة تقريبًا" across two lines at 375).
- **Notes:** Fix in the component: pass the already-pluralised phrase, e.g. `minutes: t("website.setup.minutes", { count: left })`, and drop "دقيقة" from the AR string ("… · الوقت المتبقي: {{minutes}} تقريبًا"); EN/ES likewise drop their unit word. Placeholder name stays `{{minutes}}`. Add a test for 3 and 1 minutes left.
- **Fix:** (Agent 4, 2026-11-01) `SetupGuide.tsx` passes the pluralised phrase `minutes: t("website.setup.minutes", { count: left })`; AR `website.setup.progress` drops the fixed «دقيقة» ("… · الوقت المتبقي: {{minutes}} تقريبًا"), EN drops "minutes" ("about {{minutes}} left" → "about 8 min left"). ## ETQAN-QA-1806: Payslip page scrolls sideways at 375 when the payment note has a long unbroken word
- **Feature:** M09 Payroll. **Severity:** P3. **Type:** responsive. **Easy:** yes.
- **Environment:** local docker stack (round 3 smoke), academy `qa`, Chromium via `step.mjs`. **Tag:** REAL
- **Found by:** smoke walk M09-M10 (M09-SMOKE-001); reproduced by Agent 2 (smoke triage) on 2026-11-01.
- **Preconditions:** qa-admin, AR or EN, 375x812. Payslip PAY-000011 (Paid) whose payment note has a long run of `|` with no spaces.
- **Reproduction steps:** 1. Open `/app/payroll/payslips/11`.
- **Expected:** The note wraps inside its card (as at 1440) and the page does not scroll sideways.
- **Actual:** Document scrollWidth 641 (EN) / 513 (AR) at 375. In AR the whole page is shifted: header, title, back link and facts are cut off on the right.
- **Evidence:** `qa/manual/screens/r3/smoke/fix/M09-SMOKE-001-before-payslip11-{en,ar}-375.png`; smoke shots `qa/manual/screens/r3/smoke/M09-M10/M09-SMOKE-001-payslip-note-overflow-{en,ar}-375.png`.
- **Notes:** `dashboard/src/features/payroll/PayslipPage.tsx:307` `<dd className="whitespace-pre-line break-words">` sits in a grid; `overflow-wrap: break-word` does not lower a grid item's min-content width. Use `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` and/or `min-w-0` (pattern from the QA-1450 chat-bubble fix). Related to ETQAN-QA-1212.
- **Fix:** Fix (Agent 3, round 3 smoke): `dashboard/src/features/payroll/PayslipPage.tsx` notes block gets `min-w-0` on the grid item and `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` on the `<dd>`; the same at the root in the shared `dashboard/src/components/Fact.tsx` (`min-w-0` + `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`), so no fact value in any detail grid can widen a phone page. After: scrollWidth 375 in EN and AR (`qa/manual/screens/r3/smoke/fix/M09-SMOKE-001-after-payslip11-{en,ar}-375.png`).
- **Regression test:** `dashboard/src/qa-round3-smoke.test.tsx` › ETQAN-QA-1806 (Fact render + payslip note classes).
- **Verification status:** VERIFIED (Agent 2 smoke gate cycle 1, 2026-11-01): retested in the browser at the reported language/width/theme and the other language (qa-admin). After shots in `qa/manual/screens/r3/smoke/fix/`: 1806-after-payslip11-{en,ar}-{light,dark}-375.png (full page), 1806-after-payslip11-en-1440.png (scrollWidth 375 EN+AR, note wraps in its card). Regression tests pass (`qa/manual/round-3/logs/smoke-gate1-vitest.log`, 9 files, 158 tests).
